`internal/firmware/svgen/templates/dma_tag_service.sv.tmpl`:

```tmpl
`timescale 1ns / 1ps

module pcileech_dma_tag_service #(
    parameter [7:0] TAG_FIRST = 8'h10,
    parameter integer TAG_COUNT = 16,
    parameter integer TIMEOUT_WIDTH = 24,
    parameter [TIMEOUT_WIDTH-1:0] TIMEOUT_CYCLES = {TIMEOUT_WIDTH{1'b1}}
)(
    input                         clk,
    input                         rst,
    input                         alloc_valid,
    output reg                    alloc_ready,
    output reg [7:0]              alloc_tag,
    input                         completion_valid,
    input [7:0]                   completion_tag,
    input                         completion_error,
    input                         cancel_all,
    output reg                    outcome_valid,
    input tri1                    outcome_ready,
    output reg [7:0]              outcome_tag,
    output reg [1:0]              outcome_status,
    output reg [TAG_COUNT-1:0]    active_tags,
    output reg [$clog2(TAG_COUNT+1)-1:0] outstanding_count
);
    localparam [1:0] OUTCOME_COMPLETED = 2'd0;
    localparam [1:0] OUTCOME_ERROR     = 2'd1;
    localparam [1:0] OUTCOME_TIMEOUT   = 2'd2;
    localparam [1:0] OUTCOME_CANCELLED = 2'd3;
    localparam integer INDEX_WIDTH = (TAG_COUNT <= 1) ? 1 : $clog2(TAG_COUNT);

    reg [TIMEOUT_WIDTH-1:0] age [0:TAG_COUNT-1];
    reg [1:0] terminal_status [0:TAG_COUNT-1];
    reg [TAG_COUNT-1:0] cancelled;
    reg [TAG_COUNT-1:0] cancel_reported;
    reg [TAG_COUNT-1:0] cancel_report_pending;
    reg [TAG_COUNT-1:0] terminal_pending;
    reg [INDEX_WIDTH-1:0] alloc_cursor;
    integer i;
    integer scan_index;
    integer selected;
    integer completed_index;
    integer outcome_index;
    reg timeout_found;
    reg [INDEX_WIDTH-1:0] timeout_index;
    reg cancel_found;
    reg [INDEX_WIDTH-1:0] cancel_index;
    reg terminal_found;
    reg [INDEX_WIDTH-1:0] terminal_index;
    wire outcome_ready_i = outcome_ready;

    always @(*) begin
        alloc_ready = 1'b0;
        alloc_tag = TAG_FIRST;
        selected = -1;
        scan_index = 0;
        completed_index = {24'd0, completion_tag} - {24'd0, TAG_FIRST};
        outcome_index = {24'd0, outcome_tag} - {24'd0, TAG_FIRST};
        outstanding_count = 0;
        timeout_found = 1'b0;
        timeout_index = 0;
        cancel_found = 1'b0;
        cancel_index = 0;
        terminal_found = 1'b0;
        terminal_index = 0;
        for (i = 0; i < TAG_COUNT; i = i + 1) begin
            if (active_tags[i]) begin
                outstanding_count = outstanding_count + 1'b1;
                if (!timeout_found && !terminal_pending[i] &&
                    (TIMEOUT_CYCLES != 0) &&
                    (age[i] >= TIMEOUT_CYCLES - 1'b1)) begin
                    timeout_found = 1'b1;
                    timeout_index = INDEX_WIDTH'(i);
                end
            end
            if (!cancel_found && cancel_report_pending[i]) begin
                cancel_found = 1'b1;
                cancel_index = INDEX_WIDTH'(i);
            end
            if (!terminal_found && terminal_pending[i] && !cancelled[i]) begin
                terminal_found = 1'b1;
                terminal_index = INDEX_WIDTH'(i);
            end
        end
        if (!(|cancel_report_pending) && !cancel_all) begin
            for (i = 0; i < TAG_COUNT; i = i + 1) begin
                scan_index = (int'(alloc_cursor) + i) % TAG_COUNT;
                if ((selected < 0) && !active_tags[scan_index]) begin
                    selected = scan_index;
                    alloc_ready = 1'b1;
                    alloc_tag = TAG_FIRST + 8'(scan_index);
                end
            end
        end
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            active_tags <= {TAG_COUNT{1'b0}};
            cancelled <= {TAG_COUNT{1'b0}};
            cancel_reported <= {TAG_COUNT{1'b0}};
            cancel_report_pending <= {TAG_COUNT{1'b0}};
            terminal_pending <= {TAG_COUNT{1'b0}};
            alloc_cursor <= {INDEX_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            outcome_valid <= 1'b0;
            outcome_tag <= TAG_FIRST;
            outcome_status <= OUTCOME_CANCELLED;
            for (i = 0; i < TAG_COUNT; i = i + 1) begin
                age[i] <= {TIMEOUT_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                terminal_status[i] <= OUTCOME_COMPLETED;
            end
        end else begin
            for (i = 0; i < TAG_COUNT; i = i + 1) begin
                if (active_tags[i] && !terminal_pending[i])
                    age[i] <= age[i] + 1'b1;
                if (cancel_all && active_tags[i] && !cancelled[i] &&
                    !terminal_pending[i]) begin
                    cancelled[i] <= 1'b1;
                    cancel_report_pending[i] <= 1'b1;
                end
                if (active_tags[i] && cancelled[i] && cancel_reported[i] &&
                    terminal_pending[i]) begin
                    active_tags[i] <= 1'b0;
                    cancelled[i] <= 1'b0;
                    cancel_reported[i] <= 1'b0;
                    terminal_pending[i] <= 1'b0;
                    age[i] <= {TIMEOUT_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                end
            end

            if (outcome_valid && outcome_ready_i) begin
                outcome_valid <= 1'b0;
                if (outcome_index >= 0 && outcome_index < TAG_COUNT) begin
                    if (outcome_status == OUTCOME_CANCELLED) begin
                        cancel_reported[outcome_index] <= 1'b1;
                    end else begin
                        active_tags[outcome_index] <= 1'b0;
                        terminal_pending[outcome_index] <= 1'b0;
                        age[outcome_index] <= {TIMEOUT_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                    end
                end
            end else if (!outcome_valid && cancel_found) begin
                cancel_report_pending[cancel_index] <= 1'b0;
                outcome_valid <= 1'b1;
                outcome_tag <= TAG_FIRST + 8'(cancel_index);
                outcome_status <= OUTCOME_CANCELLED;
            end else if (!outcome_valid && terminal_found) begin
                outcome_valid <= 1'b1;
                outcome_tag <= TAG_FIRST + 8'(terminal_index);
                outcome_status <= terminal_status[terminal_index];
            end

            if (completion_valid && (completion_tag >= TAG_FIRST) &&
                (completed_index < TAG_COUNT) && active_tags[completed_index] &&
                !terminal_pending[completed_index]) begin
                if (cancelled[completed_index] && cancel_reported[completed_index]) begin
                    active_tags[completed_index] <= 1'b0;
                    cancelled[completed_index] <= 1'b0;
                    cancel_reported[completed_index] <= 1'b0;
                    age[completed_index] <= {TIMEOUT_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                end else begin
                    terminal_pending[completed_index] <= 1'b1;
                    terminal_status[completed_index] <=
                        completion_error ? OUTCOME_ERROR : OUTCOME_COMPLETED;
                end
            end else if (timeout_found) begin
                if (cancelled[timeout_index] && cancel_reported[timeout_index]) begin
                    active_tags[timeout_index] <= 1'b0;
                    cancelled[timeout_index] <= 1'b0;
                    cancel_reported[timeout_index] <= 1'b0;
                    age[timeout_index] <= {TIMEOUT_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                end else begin
                    terminal_pending[timeout_index] <= 1'b1;
                    terminal_status[timeout_index] <= OUTCOME_TIMEOUT;
                end
            end

            if (alloc_valid && alloc_ready) begin
                active_tags[selected] <= 1'b1;
                cancelled[selected] <= 1'b0;
                cancel_reported[selected] <= 1'b0;
                cancel_report_pending[selected] <= 1'b0;
                terminal_pending[selected] <= 1'b0;
                terminal_status[selected] <= OUTCOME_COMPLETED;
                age[selected] <= {TIMEOUT_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                if (selected >= TAG_COUNT - 1)
                    alloc_cursor <= {INDEX_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                else
                    alloc_cursor <= INDEX_WIDTH'(selected + 1);
            end
        end
    end
endmodule

```

`internal/firmware/svgen/templates/hda_rirb_dma.sv.tmpl`:

```tmpl
//
// HDA RIRB DMA Bridge: writes RIRB responses to system memory (RIRBLBASE/RIRBUBASE)
// since hdaudio.sys reads from the DMA buffer, not MMIO regs 0x70/0x78.
//
// RIRB entry format (8 bytes, LE):
//   offset+0 [3:0]  = response type (1=VERB, 2=unsolicited)
//   offset+0 [31:4] = NID
//   offset+4 [31:0] = response payload (28-bit codec data)
//

`timescale 1ns / 1ps

module pcileech_hda_rirb_dma(
    input               rst,
    input               clk,
    input               dma_enabled,

    input [15:0]        pcie_id,        // our BDF, goes into requester ID

    // CRST falling edge: HDA reset; reset bridge to IDLE to avoid stale TLPs during re-enumeration.
    input               crst_falling,

    // handshaking with BAR module
    input               dma_req_valid,  // pulse: BAR module has response ready
    input [31:0]        dma_req_lo,     // RIRB entry [31:0]  (type + NID)
    input [31:0]        dma_req_hi,     // RIRB entry [63:32] (response payload)
    input [7:0]         dma_req_wp,     // target RIRB slot index (WP+1)
    output reg          dma_req_ready,  // 1 = ready to accept new response

    // RIRB base address from BAR module (live register values)
    input [31:0]        rirb_lbase,
    input [31:0]        rirb_ubase,

    // completion output: pulse when DMA write is done
    output reg          dma_done,       // 1-cycle pulse: write completed

    // outgoing TLP stream — gets muxed with bar controller responses
    output reg [127:0]  tlp_tx_tdata,
    output reg [3:0]    tlp_tx_tkeepdw,
    output reg          tlp_tx_tvalid,
    output reg          tlp_tx_tlast,
    output reg [8:0]    tlp_tx_tuser,
    input               tlp_tx_tready       // backpressure from downstream
);

    localparam [3:0] D_IDLE       = 4'h0;
    localparam [3:0] D_WR_TLP1    = 4'h1;  // first beat: header (+ data0 for 32-bit)
    localparam [3:0] D_WR_TLP2    = 4'h2;  // data beat 1 (32-bit: payload, 64-bit: type+NID)
    localparam [3:0] D_WR_TLP3    = 4'h3;  // data beat 2 (64-bit only: payload)
    localparam [3:0] D_DONE       = 4'h4;

    reg [3:0]  dstate;
    reg [7:0]  d_tag;               // tags start at 0x80 to avoid host tag collision
    reg [31:0] d_resp_lo;           // latched response low (type + NID)
    reg [31:0] d_resp_hi;           // latched response high (payload)
    reg [31:0] d_addr_lo;           // computed target address [31:0]
    reg [31:0] d_addr_hi;           // latched target address [63:32]
    reg        d_is_64bit;          // latched: 64-bit address mode
    reg [19:0] d_tlp_timeout;       // backpressure timeout counter (max 1M cycles = ~8ms)
    reg        d_tlp_timed_out;     // timeout flag

    // Reorder Xilinx pcie_id {func,dev,bus} -> PCIe Requester ID {bus,dev,func}.
    wire [15:0] pcie_id_fmt = {pcie_id[12:8], pcie_id[15:13], pcie_id[7:0]};

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            dstate          <= D_IDLE;
            dma_req_ready   <= 1'b0;
            dma_done        <= 1'b0;
            d_tag           <= 8'h80;
            d_resp_lo       <= 32'h0;
            d_resp_hi       <= 32'h0;
            d_addr_lo       <= 32'h0;
            d_addr_hi       <= 32'h0;
            d_is_64bit      <= 1'b0;
            d_tlp_timeout   <= 20'h0;
            d_tlp_timed_out <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            dma_done      <= 1'b0;
            // tvalid/tlast/tdata/tkeepdw/tuser are set per-state below; don't reset (backpressure needs held values).

            if (crst_falling) begin
                dstate          <= D_IDLE;
                dma_req_ready   <= 1'b1;
                d_tlp_timeout   <= 20'h0;
                d_tlp_timed_out <= 1'b0;
                d_resp_lo       <= 32'h0;
                d_resp_hi       <= 32'h0;
                d_addr_lo       <= 32'h0;
                d_addr_hi       <= 32'h0;
                d_is_64bit      <= 1'b0;
            end else begin

            case (dstate)

                // ---- idle: accept new response from BAR module ---------------
                D_IDLE: begin
                    dma_req_ready <= dma_enabled;
                    d_tlp_timeout   <= 20'h0;
                    d_tlp_timed_out <= 1'b0;

                    if (dma_enabled && dma_req_valid) begin
                        // Latch inputs; don't depend on live signals during TLP emission.
                        d_resp_lo   <= dma_req_lo;
                        d_resp_hi   <= dma_req_hi;
                        d_addr_lo   <= rirb_lbase + ({24'h0, dma_req_wp} * 8);
                        d_addr_hi   <= rirb_ubase;
                        d_is_64bit  <= |rirb_ubase;
                        d_tag       <= (d_tag >= 8'hFF) ? 8'h80 : d_tag + 1'b1;

                        dma_req_ready <= 1'b0;
                        dstate <= D_WR_TLP1;
                    end
                end

                // ---- first beat: header (64-bit) or header+data0 (32-bit) ----
                D_WR_TLP1: begin
                    d_tlp_timeout <= d_tlp_timeout + 1'b1;
                    if (d_tlp_timeout >= 20'hFFFFF)
                        d_tlp_timed_out <= 1'b1;
                    if (tlp_tx_tready)
                        dstate <= D_WR_TLP2;
                end

                // ---- data beat 1: type+NID (64-bit) or payload (32-bit) ------
                D_WR_TLP2: begin
                    d_tlp_timeout <= d_tlp_timeout + 1'b1;
                    if (d_tlp_timeout >= 20'hFFFFF)
                        d_tlp_timed_out <= 1'b1;
                    if (tlp_tx_tready) begin
                        if (d_is_64bit) begin
                            dstate <= D_WR_TLP3;
                        end else begin
                            dstate <= D_DONE;
                        end
                    end
                end

                // ---- data beat 2: payload (64-bit only) ----------------------
                D_WR_TLP3: begin
                    d_tlp_timeout <= d_tlp_timeout + 1'b1;
                    if (d_tlp_timeout >= 20'hFFFFF)
                        d_tlp_timed_out <= 1'b1;
                    if (tlp_tx_tready)
                        dstate <= D_DONE;
                end

                // ---- signal completion to BAR module -------------------------
                D_DONE: begin
                    dma_done        <= 1'b1;
                    dma_req_ready   <= 1'b1;
                    dstate          <= D_IDLE;
                end

                default: begin
                    dstate <= D_IDLE;
                end
            endcase
            end // crst_falling guard

        end
    end

    // Combinational TLP output per state; values held during backpressure (state advances only on tready=1).
    always @(*) begin
        // Default: inactive
        tlp_tx_tdata    = 128'h0;
        tlp_tx_tkeepdw  = 4'b0000;
        tlp_tx_tlast    = 1'b0;
        tlp_tx_tuser    = 9'h0;
        tlp_tx_tvalid   = 1'b0;

        case (dstate)
            D_WR_TLP1: begin
                if (d_is_64bit) begin
                    // 64-bit MWr: 4DW header (Fmt=011, Type=MWr, Length=2 DW); BE=0xF/0xF.
                    tlp_tx_tdata[31:0]   = {
                        3'b011, 5'b00000,         // Fmt, Type
                        1'b0, 3'b000,             // R, TC
                        1'b0, 1'b0, 1'b0, 1'b0,  // Attr[2], R, IDO, R
                        1'b0, 1'b0, 2'b00,        // TD, EP, Attr[1:0]
                        2'b00, 10'h002            // AT, Length
                    };
                    tlp_tx_tdata[63:32]  = {pcie_id_fmt, d_tag, 4'hF, 4'hF};
                    tlp_tx_tdata[95:64]  = d_addr_hi;
                    tlp_tx_tdata[127:96] = {d_addr_lo[31:2], 2'b00};
                    tlp_tx_tkeepdw = 4'b1111;
                    tlp_tx_tuser   = {8'h00, 1'b1};  // first=1
                end else begin
                    // 32-bit MWr: 3DW header + 1st data DW (Fmt=010, Type=MWr, Length=2 DW); BE=0xF/0xF.
                    tlp_tx_tdata[31:0]   = {
                        3'b010, 5'b00000,         // Fmt, Type
                        1'b0, 3'b000,             // R, TC
                        1'b0, 1'b0, 1'b0, 1'b0,  // Attr[2], R, IDO, R
                        1'b0, 1'b0, 2'b00,        // TD, EP, Attr[1:0]
                        2'b00, 10'h002            // AT, Length
                    };
                    tlp_tx_tdata[63:32]  = {pcie_id_fmt, d_tag, 4'hF, 4'hF};
                    tlp_tx_tdata[95:64]  = {d_addr_lo[31:2], 2'b00};
                    tlp_tx_tdata[127:96] = d_resp_lo;
                    tlp_tx_tkeepdw = 4'b1111;
                    tlp_tx_tuser   = {8'h00, 1'b1};  // first=1
                end
                tlp_tx_tvalid = 1'b1;
            end

            D_WR_TLP2: begin
                if (d_is_64bit) begin
                    // 64-bit: first data DW (type + NID)
                    tlp_tx_tdata[31:0]   = d_resp_lo;
                    tlp_tx_tkeepdw = 4'b0001;
                    tlp_tx_tuser   = 9'h0;
                end else begin
                    // 32-bit: second data DW (payload), last beat
                    tlp_tx_tdata[31:0]   = d_resp_hi;
                    tlp_tx_tkeepdw = 4'b0001;
                    tlp_tx_tlast   = 1'b1;
                    tlp_tx_tuser   = 9'h0;
                end
                tlp_tx_tvalid = 1'b1;
            end

            D_WR_TLP3: begin
                // 64-bit: second data DW (payload), last beat
                tlp_tx_tdata[31:0]   = d_resp_hi;
                tlp_tx_tkeepdw = 4'b0001;
                tlp_tx_tlast   = 1'b1;
                tlp_tx_tuser   = 9'h0;
                tlp_tx_tvalid = 1'b1;
            end

            default: begin
                // IDLE, DONE: no output
            end
        endcase
    end

endmodule

```

`internal/firmware/svgen/templates/interrupt_service.sv.tmpl`:

```tmpl
`timescale 1ns / 1ps

module pcileech_interrupt_service #(
    parameter integer NUM_VECTORS = 1,
    parameter integer DEFER_MSIX_CLEAR = 0
)(
    input               clk,
    input               rst,
    input               quiesce,
    input               msix_mode,
    input               function_enable,
    input               function_mask,
    input               event_valid,
    input [15:0]        event_vector,
    output reg [15:0]   vector_select,
    input               vector_masked,
    input               delivery_ready,
    input               delivery_done,
    output reg          delivery_valid,
    output reg [15:0]   delivery_vector,
    output reg          msi_pulse,
    output reg          pba_set_valid,
    output reg          pba_clear_valid,
    output reg [15:0]   pba_vector
);
    localparam Q_SELECT = 2'd0;
    localparam Q_WAIT   = 2'd1;
    localparam Q_CHECK  = 2'd2;
    localparam integer INDEX_WIDTH = (NUM_VECTORS <= 1) ? 1 : $clog2(NUM_VECTORS);

    reg [NUM_VECTORS-1:0] pending;
    reg [INDEX_WIDTH-1:0] scan_vector;
    reg [1:0] query_state;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        pba_set_valid <= 1'b0;
        pba_clear_valid <= 1'b0;

        if (rst) begin
            pending <= {NUM_VECTORS{1'b0}};
            vector_select <= 16'd0;
            delivery_valid <= 1'b0;
            delivery_vector <= 16'd0;
            msi_pulse <= 1'b0;
            scan_vector <= {INDEX_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            query_state <= Q_SELECT;
            pba_vector <= 16'd0;
        end else if (quiesce) begin
            delivery_valid <= 1'b0;
            msi_pulse <= 1'b0;
            query_state <= Q_SELECT;
            if (event_valid && (event_vector < 16'(NUM_VECTORS))) begin
                pending[event_vector[INDEX_WIDTH-1:0]] <= 1'b1;
                if (msix_mode) begin
                    pba_set_valid <= 1'b1;
                    pba_vector <= event_vector;
                end
            end
        end else begin
            if (event_valid && (event_vector < 16'(NUM_VECTORS))) begin
                pending[event_vector[INDEX_WIDTH-1:0]] <= 1'b1;
                if (msix_mode) begin
                    pba_set_valid <= 1'b1;
                    pba_vector <= event_vector;
                end
            end

            if (delivery_valid) begin
                if (DEFER_MSIX_CLEAR && msix_mode) begin
                    if (delivery_done) begin
                        delivery_valid <= 1'b0;
                        if (!(event_valid && (event_vector == delivery_vector)))
                            pending[delivery_vector[INDEX_WIDTH-1:0]] <= 1'b0;
                        pba_clear_valid <= 1'b1;
                        pba_vector <= delivery_vector;
                    end
                end else if (delivery_ready) begin
                    delivery_valid <= 1'b0;
                    if (!(event_valid && (event_vector == delivery_vector)))
                        pending[delivery_vector[INDEX_WIDTH-1:0]] <= 1'b0;
                    pba_clear_valid <= 1'b1;
                    pba_vector <= delivery_vector;
                end
            end else if (msi_pulse) begin
                if (delivery_ready) begin
                    msi_pulse <= 1'b0;
                    if (!(event_valid && (event_vector == delivery_vector)))
                        pending[delivery_vector[INDEX_WIDTH-1:0]] <= 1'b0;
                end
            end else begin
                case (query_state)
                    Q_SELECT: begin
                        vector_select <= 16'(scan_vector);
                        query_state <= Q_WAIT;
                    end
                    Q_WAIT: query_state <= Q_CHECK;
                    Q_CHECK: begin
                        if (pending[vector_select[INDEX_WIDTH-1:0]] && function_enable &&
                            !function_mask) begin
                            delivery_vector <= vector_select;
                            if (!msix_mode)
                                msi_pulse <= 1'b1;
                            else if (!vector_masked)
                                delivery_valid <= 1'b1;
                        end
                        if (scan_vector == INDEX_WIDTH'(NUM_VECTORS - 1))
                            scan_vector <= {INDEX_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                        else
                            scan_vector <= scan_vector + 1'b1;
                        query_state <= Q_SELECT;
                    end
                    default: query_state <= Q_SELECT;
                endcase
            end
        end
    end
endmodule

```

`internal/firmware/svgen/templates/latency_emulator.sv.tmpl`:

```tmpl
// TLP Latency Emulator - Auto-generated by PCILeechGen
// Device: {{ hex04 .DeviceIDs.VendorID }}:{{ hex04 .DeviceIDs.DeviceID }}

`timescale 1ns / 1ps

module tlp_latency_emulator #(
    parameter MIN_LATENCY_CYCLES = {{ .LatencyConfig.MinCycles }},
    parameter MAX_LATENCY_CYCLES = {{ .LatencyConfig.MaxCycles }},
    parameter AVG_LATENCY_CYCLES = {{ .LatencyConfig.AvgCycles }},
    parameter ENABLE_JITTER      = 1,
    parameter BURST_CORRELATION  = {{ .LatencyConfig.BurstCorrelation }},
    parameter THERMAL_DRIFT_PERIOD = {{ .LatencyConfig.ThermalPeriod }},
    parameter WR_MIN_LATENCY     = {{ .LatencyConfig.WrMinCycles }},
    parameter WR_MAX_LATENCY     = {{ .LatencyConfig.WrMaxCycles }},
    parameter CPL_TIMEOUT_CYCLES = {{ .LatencyConfig.CplTimeoutCycles }},
    parameter [31:0] PRNG_SEED_0 = 32'h{{ hex08 (index .PRNGSeeds 0) }},
    parameter [31:0] PRNG_SEED_1 = 32'h{{ hex08 (index .PRNGSeeds 1) }},
    parameter [31:0] PRNG_SEED_2 = 32'h{{ hex08 (index .PRNGSeeds 2) }},
    parameter [31:0] PRNG_SEED_3 = 32'h{{ hex08 (index .PRNGSeeds 3) }}
)(
    input wire          clk,
    input wire          rst,

    // CRST falling edge: HDA controller reset. Reset internal state to
    // prevent stale request from blocking new responses after re-enable.
    input wire          crst_falling,

    // read path
    input wire          req_valid,
    input wire [87:0]   req_ctx,
    input wire [31:0]   req_data,
    input wire [31:0]   req_addr,
    output reg          req_ready,

    output reg          rsp_valid,
    output reg [87:0]   rsp_ctx,
    output reg [31:0]   rsp_data,
    input wire          rsp_ready,

    output wire         busy,

    // write acknowledge path
    input wire          wr_valid,
    input wire [31:0]   wr_addr,
    output reg          wr_ack
);

    reg request_pending;
    assign busy = request_pending;

    reg [7:0] latency_counter;
    reg [7:0] target_latency;

    reg [87:0] stored_ctx;
    reg [31:0] stored_data;

    reg [31:0] prev_addr;
    reg [7:0]  prev_latency;
    reg        prev_valid;
    reg [3:0]  idle_counter;

    // completion timeout counter
    reg [18:0] timeout_counter;
    wire timeout_expired = (CPL_TIMEOUT_CYCLES > 0) && request_pending &&
                           (timeout_counter >= CPL_TIMEOUT_CYCLES[18:0]);

    // xorshift128+ PRNG
    reg [31:0] prng_s0, prng_s1, prng_s2, prng_s3;
    wire [31:0] prng_out;
    wire [31:0] prng_next_s0, prng_next_s3;

    assign prng_next_s0 = prng_s0 ^ (prng_s0 << 11);
    assign prng_next_s3 = prng_s3 ^ (prng_s3 >> 19) ^ prng_next_s0 ^ (prng_next_s0 >> 8);
    assign prng_out = prng_s3 + prng_s0;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            prng_s0 <= PRNG_SEED_0;
            prng_s1 <= PRNG_SEED_1;
            prng_s2 <= PRNG_SEED_2;
            prng_s3 <= PRNG_SEED_3;
        end else if (crst_falling) begin
            prng_s0 <= PRNG_SEED_0;
            prng_s1 <= PRNG_SEED_1;
            prng_s2 <= PRNG_SEED_2;
            prng_s3 <= PRNG_SEED_3;
        end else begin
            // Advance every cycle to prevent deterministic thermal drift during idle
            prng_s0 <= prng_s1;
            prng_s1 <= prng_s2;
            prng_s2 <= prng_s3;
            prng_s3 <= prng_next_s3;
        end
    end

    // thermal drift
    reg [15:0] thermal_counter;
    reg [3:0]  thermal_offset;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            thermal_counter <= 16'h0;
            thermal_offset  <= 4'h0;
        end else if (crst_falling) begin
            thermal_counter <= 16'h0;
            thermal_offset  <= 4'h0;
        end else begin
            thermal_counter <= thermal_counter + 1'b1;
            if (thermal_counter == THERMAL_DRIFT_PERIOD[15:0]) begin
                thermal_counter <= 16'h0;
                if (prng_out[0])
                    thermal_offset <= (thermal_offset < 4'hF) ? thermal_offset + 1'b1 : thermal_offset;
                else
                    thermal_offset <= (thermal_offset > 4'h0) ? thermal_offset - 1'b1 : thermal_offset;
            end
        end
    end

    // address-region latency variation
    wire [2:0] addr_region = req_addr[14:12];
    wire [7:0] region_adjust = (addr_region == 3'h0) ? 8'h00 :
                               (addr_region == 3'h1) ? 8'h02 :
                               (addr_region == 3'h2) ? 8'h04 :
                               (addr_region == 3'h3) ? 8'h01 :
                               8'h03;

    // burst correlation
    wire is_sequential = prev_valid && ((req_addr[31:8] == prev_addr[31:8]) ||
                                        (req_addr[31:8] == prev_addr[31:8] + 1'b1));
    wire [7:0] corr_weight = is_sequential ? BURST_CORRELATION[7:0] : 8'h00;
    wire [7:0] correlated_latency = ((prev_latency * corr_weight) +
                                     (prng_out[7:0] * (8'hFF - corr_weight))) >> 8;

    // donor-profiled CDF lookup
    reg [7:0] cdf_table [0:15];
    initial begin
        cdf_table[0]  = 8'd{{ cdfVal .LatencyConfig.CDF 0 }};
        cdf_table[1]  = 8'd{{ cdfVal .LatencyConfig.CDF 1 }};
        cdf_table[2]  = 8'd{{ cdfVal .LatencyConfig.CDF 2 }};
        cdf_table[3]  = 8'd{{ cdfVal .LatencyConfig.CDF 3 }};
        cdf_table[4]  = 8'd{{ cdfVal .LatencyConfig.CDF 4 }};
        cdf_table[5]  = 8'd{{ cdfVal .LatencyConfig.CDF 5 }};
        cdf_table[6]  = 8'd{{ cdfVal .LatencyConfig.CDF 6 }};
        cdf_table[7]  = 8'd{{ cdfVal .LatencyConfig.CDF 7 }};
        cdf_table[8]  = 8'd{{ cdfVal .LatencyConfig.CDF 8 }};
        cdf_table[9]  = 8'd{{ cdfVal .LatencyConfig.CDF 9 }};
        cdf_table[10] = 8'd{{ cdfVal .LatencyConfig.CDF 10 }};
        cdf_table[11] = 8'd{{ cdfVal .LatencyConfig.CDF 11 }};
        cdf_table[12] = 8'd{{ cdfVal .LatencyConfig.CDF 12 }};
        cdf_table[13] = 8'd{{ cdfVal .LatencyConfig.CDF 13 }};
        cdf_table[14] = 8'd{{ cdfVal .LatencyConfig.CDF 14 }};
        cdf_table[15] = 8'd255;
    end

    reg [3:0] cdf_bucket;
    always @(*) begin
        cdf_bucket = 4'd15;
        if (prng_out[7:0] < cdf_table[0])       cdf_bucket = 4'd0;
        else if (prng_out[7:0] < cdf_table[1])  cdf_bucket = 4'd1;
        else if (prng_out[7:0] < cdf_table[2])  cdf_bucket = 4'd2;
        else if (prng_out[7:0] < cdf_table[3])  cdf_bucket = 4'd3;
        else if (prng_out[7:0] < cdf_table[4])  cdf_bucket = 4'd4;
        else if (prng_out[7:0] < cdf_table[5])  cdf_bucket = 4'd5;
        else if (prng_out[7:0] < cdf_table[6])  cdf_bucket = 4'd6;
        else if (prng_out[7:0] < cdf_table[7])  cdf_bucket = 4'd7;
        else if (prng_out[7:0] < cdf_table[8])  cdf_bucket = 4'd8;
        else if (prng_out[7:0] < cdf_table[9])  cdf_bucket = 4'd9;
        else if (prng_out[7:0] < cdf_table[10]) cdf_bucket = 4'd10;
        else if (prng_out[7:0] < cdf_table[11]) cdf_bucket = 4'd11;
        else if (prng_out[7:0] < cdf_table[12]) cdf_bucket = 4'd12;
        else if (prng_out[7:0] < cdf_table[13]) cdf_bucket = 4'd13;
        else if (prng_out[7:0] < cdf_table[14]) cdf_bucket = 4'd14;
    end

    // read latency computation
    wire [7:0] latency_range = MAX_LATENCY_CYCLES - MIN_LATENCY_CYCLES + 1;
    wire [7:0] cdf_latency = MIN_LATENCY_CYCLES + ((cdf_bucket * latency_range) >> 4);
    wire [7:0] base_jitter = is_sequential ? correlated_latency : cdf_latency;
    wire [7:0] thermal_adj = base_jitter + $signed(thermal_offset);
    wire [7:0] region_adj  = thermal_adj + region_adjust;
    wire [7:0] jittered    = (MIN_LATENCY_CYCLES + region_adj > MAX_LATENCY_CYCLES) ? MAX_LATENCY_CYCLES :
                             (MIN_LATENCY_CYCLES + region_adj < MIN_LATENCY_CYCLES) ? MIN_LATENCY_CYCLES :
                             MIN_LATENCY_CYCLES + region_adj;
    wire [7:0] computed_latency = ENABLE_JITTER ? jittered : AVG_LATENCY_CYCLES;

    // write latency computation
    wire [7:0] wr_range = WR_MAX_LATENCY - WR_MIN_LATENCY + 1;
    wire [7:0] wr_latency = WR_MIN_LATENCY + (prng_out[15:8] % wr_range);

    reg [7:0] wr_counter;
    reg [7:0] wr_target;
    reg       wr_pending;

    always @(*) begin
        req_ready = !request_pending;
    end

    // read latency FSM
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            request_pending <= 1'b0;
            latency_counter <= 8'h0;
            target_latency  <= AVG_LATENCY_CYCLES;
            rsp_valid       <= 1'b0;
            stored_ctx      <= 88'h0;
            stored_data     <= 32'h0;
            prev_addr       <= 32'h0;
            prev_latency    <= AVG_LATENCY_CYCLES;
            prev_valid      <= 1'b0;
            idle_counter    <= 4'h0;
            timeout_counter <= 19'h0;
        end else if (crst_falling) begin
            // CRST soft reset: clear pending request state.
            // Prevents stale request from blocking new responses after re-enable.
            // CRITICAL: stored data and tracking state must also be cleared.
            // Without clearing stored_ctx/stored_data, a subsequent timeout
            // would release 0xFFFFFFFF with stale ctx, producing a spurious
            // BAR0 read completion that corrupts the host's read pipeline.
            request_pending <= 1'b0;
            rsp_valid       <= 1'b0;
            latency_counter <= 8'h0;
            timeout_counter <= 19'h0;
            stored_ctx      <= 88'h0;
            stored_data     <= 32'h0;
            prev_addr       <= 32'h0;
            prev_latency    <= AVG_LATENCY_CYCLES;
            prev_valid      <= 1'b0;
            idle_counter    <= 4'h0;
            target_latency  <= AVG_LATENCY_CYCLES;
        end else begin
            if (rsp_valid && rsp_ready)
                rsp_valid <= 1'b0;

            // idle tracking: decay burst correlation when no requests arrive
            if (!request_pending && !(req_valid && req_ready))
                idle_counter <= idle_counter + 1'b1;
            else if (req_valid && req_ready)
                idle_counter <= 4'h0;

            if (idle_counter >= 4'hF)
                prev_valid <= 1'b0;

            if (request_pending) begin
                timeout_counter <= timeout_counter + 1'b1;

                if (timeout_expired) begin
                    // timeout: release with stored data (UR would need TLP layer changes)
                    rsp_valid       <= 1'b1;
                    rsp_ctx         <= stored_ctx;
                    rsp_data        <= 32'hFFFFFFFF;
                    request_pending <= 1'b0;
                    latency_counter <= 8'h0;
                    timeout_counter <= 19'h0;
                    prev_valid      <= 1'b0;
                end else if (latency_counter < target_latency) begin
                    latency_counter <= latency_counter + 8'h1;
                end else if (!rsp_valid || rsp_ready) begin
                    rsp_valid       <= 1'b1;
                    rsp_ctx         <= stored_ctx;
                    rsp_data        <= stored_data;
                    request_pending <= 1'b0;
                    latency_counter <= 8'h0;
                    timeout_counter <= 19'h0;
                    prev_latency    <= target_latency;
                    prev_valid      <= 1'b1;
                end
            end else if (req_valid && req_ready) begin
                request_pending <= 1'b1;
                stored_ctx      <= req_ctx;
                stored_data     <= req_data;
                prev_addr       <= req_addr;
                latency_counter <= 8'h0;
                timeout_counter <= 19'h0;
                target_latency  <= computed_latency;
            end
        end
    end

    // write acknowledge FSM - delays wr_ack to emulate MMIO write latency
    // wr_ack is level-based: high when ready to accept a new write,
    // low while emulating write latency for the previous write.
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            wr_pending <= 1'b0;
            wr_counter <= 8'h0;
            wr_target  <= WR_MIN_LATENCY;
            wr_ack     <= 1'b1;
        end else if (crst_falling) begin
            // CRST soft reset: clear write pending state.
            wr_pending <= 1'b0;
            wr_counter <= 8'h0;
            wr_ack     <= 1'b1;
        end else begin
            if (wr_pending) begin
                if (wr_counter < wr_target) begin
                    wr_counter <= wr_counter + 8'h1;
                end else begin
                    wr_ack     <= 1'b1;  // latency complete, ready for next write
                    wr_pending <= 1'b0;
                    wr_counter <= 8'h0;
                end
            end else if (wr_valid) begin
                wr_pending <= 1'b1;
                wr_ack     <= 1'b0;  // busy: block new writes until latency completes
                wr_counter <= 8'h0;
                wr_target  <= wr_latency;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
```

`internal/firmware/svgen/templates/lifecycle_service.sv.tmpl`:

```tmpl
`timescale 1ns / 1ps

module pcileech_lifecycle_service(
    input              clk,
    input              fundamental_reset,
    input              flr_in_process,
    input [1:0]        pm_dstate,
    input              memory_space_enable,
    input              bus_master_enable,
    input              turnoff_pending,
    input              link_up,
    output             device_reset,
    output             io_enabled,
    output             dma_enabled,
    output             quiesce,
    output reg [31:0]  generation
);
    wire active = !device_reset && (pm_dstate == 2'b00) &&
                  !turnoff_pending && link_up;

    assign device_reset = fundamental_reset || flr_in_process;
    assign io_enabled   = active && memory_space_enable;
    assign dma_enabled  = active && bus_master_enable;
    assign quiesce      = !dma_enabled;

    reg reset_d = 1'b0;
    initial generation = 32'd0;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        reset_d <= device_reset;
        if (device_reset && !reset_d)
            generation <= generation + 1'b1;
    end
endmodule
```

`internal/firmware/svgen/templates/msix_table.sv.tmpl`:

```tmpl
//
// MSI-X Table - {{ .MSIXConfig.NumVectors }} vectors (offsets computed from Bar0Size for NVMe/large)
// Auto-generated by PCILeechGen
// Device: {{ hex04 .DeviceIDs.VendorID }}:{{ hex04 .DeviceIDs.DeviceID }}
//

`timescale 1ns / 1ps

module pcileech_msix_table #(
    parameter NUM_VECTORS    = {{ .MSIXConfig.NumVectors }},
    parameter TABLE_BIR      = {{ .MSIXConfig.TableBIR }},
    parameter TABLE_OFFSET   = 32'h{{ printf "%08X" .MSIXConfig.TableOffset }},
    parameter PBA_BIR        = {{ .MSIXConfig.PBABIR }},
    parameter PBA_OFFSET     = 32'h{{ printf "%08X" .MSIXConfig.PBAOffset }},
    parameter TABLE_ENTRIES  = NUM_VECTORS * 4
)(
    input               rst,
    input               clk,

    // BAR write interface
    input [31:0]        wr_addr,
    input [31:0]        wr_data,
    input [3:0]         wr_be,
    input               wr_valid,
    input               wr_table_select,
    input               wr_pba_select,

    // BAR read interface
    input [87:0]        rd_req_ctx,
    input [31:0]        rd_req_addr,
    input               rd_req_valid,
    input               rd_table_select,
    input               rd_pba_select,

    output reg [87:0]   rd_rsp_ctx,
    output reg [31:0]   rd_rsp_data,
    output reg          rd_rsp_valid,
    output reg [2:0]    rd_rsp_bir,

    // Indexed vector read for the NVMe responder: admin completions use vector
    // 0, the I/O queue uses its programmed IV.  Registered (1-cycle latency) so
    // it infers the same block RAM as the table; vector_select is stable for
    // many cycles before the responder consumes vector_addr/data/masked.
    input  [15:0]       vector_select,
    output [63:0]       vector_addr,
    output [31:0]       vector_data,
    output              vector_masked,

    // Device-side PBA pending-bit set for a masked vector (spec 6.8.3.4).
    input               pba_set_valid,
    input  [15:0]       pba_set_vector,
    input               pba_clear_valid,
    input  [15:0]       pba_clear_vector,

    output              addr_hit  // request targets MSI-X region
);

    localparam TABLE_END = TABLE_OFFSET + NUM_VECTORS * 16;
    localparam PBA_SIZE  = ((NUM_VECTORS + 63) / 64) * 8;
    localparam PBA_END   = PBA_OFFSET + PBA_SIZE;

    wire [31:0] wr_offset     = wr_addr;
    wire [31:0] rd_req_offset = rd_req_addr;

    wire is_table = rd_table_select && (rd_req_offset >= TABLE_OFFSET) && (rd_req_offset < TABLE_END);
    wire is_pba   = rd_pba_select && (rd_req_offset >= PBA_OFFSET) && (rd_req_offset < PBA_END);
    assign addr_hit = rd_req_valid && (is_table || is_pba);

    wire wr_is_table = wr_table_select && (wr_offset >= TABLE_OFFSET) && (wr_offset < TABLE_END);
    reg [31:0] msix_table_ram [0:TABLE_ENTRIES-1];

    initial begin
        $readmemh("msix_table_init.hex", msix_table_ram);
    end

    // Indexed vector read (see port comment).  Each vector occupies 4 DWORDs
    // (addr_lo, addr_hi, data, ctrl).  Clamp an out-of-range select to vector 0.
    wire [31:0] vsel_base = ((vector_select >= NUM_VECTORS) ? 32'd0
                                                            : {16'd0, vector_select}) << 2;
    reg [63:0] vector_addr_r;
    reg [31:0] vector_data_r;
    reg        vector_masked_r;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        vector_addr_r   <= {msix_table_ram[vsel_base + 32'd1], msix_table_ram[vsel_base]};
        vector_data_r   <= msix_table_ram[vsel_base + 32'd2];
        vector_masked_r <= msix_table_ram[vsel_base + 32'd3][0];
    end
    assign vector_addr   = vector_addr_r;
    assign vector_data   = vector_data_r;
    assign vector_masked = vector_masked_r;

    // PBA - all cleared initially
    reg [31:0] msix_pba [0:((NUM_VECTORS+31)/32)-1];
    wire _unused_wr_pba_select = wr_pba_select;

    integer k;
    initial begin
        for (k = 0; k < (NUM_VECTORS+31)/32; k = k + 1)
            msix_pba[k] = 32'h0;
    end

    // host write logic - table entries only (PBA is host read-only; pending bits are set device-side below)
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (!rst && wr_valid && wr_is_table) begin
            if (wr_offset[3:2] == 2'd3) begin
                // Vector control dword: only the Mask bit (bit 0) is writable;
                // PCIe reserves bits 31:1 as read-zero (spec 6.8.3.2).
                msix_table_ram[(wr_offset - TABLE_OFFSET) >> 2] <= wr_data & 32'h00000001;
            end else begin
                if (wr_be[0]) msix_table_ram[(wr_offset - TABLE_OFFSET) >> 2][7:0]   <= wr_data[7:0];
                if (wr_be[1]) msix_table_ram[(wr_offset - TABLE_OFFSET) >> 2][15:8]  <= wr_data[15:8];
                if (wr_be[2]) msix_table_ram[(wr_offset - TABLE_OFFSET) >> 2][23:16] <= wr_data[23:16];
                if (wr_be[3]) msix_table_ram[(wr_offset - TABLE_OFFSET) >> 2][31:24] <= wr_data[31:24];
            end
        end
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            for (k = 0; k < (NUM_VECTORS+31)/32; k = k + 1)
                msix_pba[k] <= 32'h0;
        end else begin
            if (pba_clear_valid && (pba_clear_vector < NUM_VECTORS))
                msix_pba[int'(pba_clear_vector[15:5])][pba_clear_vector[4:0]] <= 1'b0;
            if (pba_set_valid && (pba_set_vector < NUM_VECTORS))
                msix_pba[int'(pba_set_vector[15:5])][pba_set_vector[4:0]] <= 1'b1;
        end
    end

    // read logic - 2-cycle pipeline
    reg [87:0] rd_ctx_d1;
    reg        rd_valid_d1;
    reg [31:0] rd_data_d1;
    reg [2:0]  rd_bir_d1;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        rd_ctx_d1   <= rd_req_ctx;
        rd_valid_d1 <= addr_hit;
        rd_bir_d1     <= is_table ? TABLE_BIR[2:0] : PBA_BIR[2:0];

        if (addr_hit) begin
            if (is_table)
                rd_data_d1 <= msix_table_ram[(rd_req_offset - TABLE_OFFSET) >> 2];
            else if (is_pba)
                rd_data_d1 <= msix_pba[(rd_req_offset - PBA_OFFSET) >> 2];
            else
                rd_data_d1 <= 32'h0;
        end else begin
            rd_data_d1 <= 32'h0;
        end
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        rd_rsp_ctx   <= rd_ctx_d1;
        rd_rsp_valid <= rd_valid_d1;
```

```tmpl
    function [31:0] identify_data_word;
        input [12:0] base;
        input [10:0] dw_index;

        begin
            identify_data_word = rom_data;
            if (base == 13'h0000) begin

                    // only optional feature fields are substituted below.

                    11'd66: identify_data_word = 32'h01570000; // WCTEMP=343K.
                    11'd67: identify_data_word = 32'h00000166; // CCTEMP=358K.
                    11'd70: identify_data_word = nvme_disk_bytes[31:0];  // TNVMCAP low.
                    11'd71: identify_data_word = nvme_disk_bytes[63:32];
                    11'd72: identify_data_word = nvme_disk_bytes[95:64];

                    11'd75: identify_data_word = 32'h00000000;
                    11'd76: identify_data_word = 32'h00000000;
                    11'd77: identify_data_word = 32'h00000000;
                    11'd128: identify_data_word = 32'h00004466; // SQES=64B, CQES=16B.
                    11'd129: identify_data_word = 32'h00000001; // NN: one namespace.
                    11'd130: identify_data_word = 32'h0000000C; // Dataset Management and Write Zeroes.
                    11'd131: identify_data_word = 32'h00000100; // VWC present.
                    11'd512: identify_data_word = 32'h00000320; // PSD0: 8.00 W active state.
                    11'd513: identify_data_word = 32'h00000000;
                    11'd514: identify_data_word = 32'h00000000;
                    11'd515: identify_data_word = 32'h00000000;
                    11'd516: identify_data_word = 32'h00000000;
                    11'd517: identify_data_word = 32'h00000000;
                    11'd518: identify_data_word = 32'h00000000;
                    11'd519: identify_data_word = 32'h00000000;
                    default: identify_data_word = rom_data;
                endcase
            end else if (base == 13'h1000) begin
                case (dw_index)
                    11'd0,
                    11'd2,
                    11'd4: identify_data_word = NVME_ADVERTISED_LBAS[31:0];
                    11'd1,
                    11'd3,
                    11'd5: identify_data_word = NVME_ADVERTISED_LBAS[63:32];
                    11'd6: identify_data_word = 32'h00000000; // One LBA format, no metadata.
                    11'd7: identify_data_word = 32'h00000000; // No PI/DPS/namespace features.
                    11'd32: identify_data_word = 32'h00090000; // LBAF0: 512-byte LBAs.
                    default: identify_data_word = 32'h00000000;
                endcase

        end
    endfunction

                    timing_profile_us = 32'd28 + {29'h0, jitter[2:0]};
                TIMING_READ_HIT:
                    timing_profile_us = 32'd70 + timing_min_u32(lba32, 32'd32) +
                                        {28'h0, jitter[3:0]};
                TIMING_READ_MISS_ZERO:
                    timing_profile_us = 32'd115 + timing_min_u32({lba32[30:0], 1'b0}, 32'd64) +
                                        {27'h0, jitter[4:0]};
                TIMING_WRITE:
                    timing_profile_us = 32'd150 + timing_min_u32((lba32 + {lba32[30:0], 1'b0}), 32'd128) +
                                        {26'h0, jitter[5:0]};
                TIMING_WRITE_ZEROES:
                    timing_profile_us = 32'd180 + timing_min_u32(lba32, 32'd128) +
                                        {26'h0, jitter[5:0]};
                TIMING_FLUSH:
                    timing_profile_us = 32'd220 + {26'h0, jitter[5:0]};
                TIMING_DSM:
                    timing_profile_us = 32'd250 + timing_min_u32({range32[28:0], 3'b000}, 32'd1000) +
                                        {25'h0, jitter[6:0]};
                TIMING_FORMAT:
                    timing_profile_us = 32'd8000 + {20'h00000, jitter[11:0]};
                TIMING_ERROR:
                    timing_profile_us = 32'd12 + {30'h0, jitter[1:0]};
                default:
                    timing_profile_us = 32'd12 + {30'h0, jitter[1:0]};
            endcase
        end
    endfunction

    function [31:0] timing_profile_cycles;
        input [3:0]  cls;
        input [16:0] lbas;
        input [7:0]  dsm_ranges;
        input [15:0] jitter;
        begin
            timing_profile_cycles = timing_us_to_cycles(timing_profile_us(cls, lbas, dsm_ranges, jitter));
        end
    endfunction

    function [31:0] log_page_word;
        input [10:0] dw_index;
        begin
            case (cmd_cdw10[7:0])
                LOG_PAGE_SUPPORTED: begin
                    case (dw_index[7:0])
                        8'h00: log_page_word = 32'h01010101; // 00h, 01h, 02h, 03h supported.
                        8'd48: log_page_word = 32'h00000001; // C0h vendor diagnostics.
                        default: log_page_word = 32'h00000000;
                    endcase
                end
                LOG_PAGE_ERROR: begin
                    case (dw_index[7:0])
                        8'd0: log_page_word = last_error_count[31:0];
                        8'd1: log_page_word = last_error_count[63:32];
                        8'd2: log_page_word = {last_error_cid, last_error_sqid};
                        8'd3: log_page_word = {last_error_peloc, last_error_status};
                        8'd4: log_page_word = last_error_lba[31:0];
                        8'd5: log_page_word = last_error_lba[63:32];
                        8'd6: log_page_word = last_error_nsid;
                        8'd7: log_page_word = 32'h00000000;
                        default: log_page_word = 32'h00000000;
                    endcase
                end
                LOG_PAGE_SMART: begin
                    case (dw_index[7:0])
                        8'd0:  log_page_word = {8'd100, smart_temp_k, smart_warning_byte};
                        8'd1:  log_page_word = 32'h0000000A; // spare threshold 10%, used 0%.
                        8'd8:  log_page_word = stat_data_units_read[31:0];
                        8'd9:  log_page_word = stat_data_units_read[63:32];
                        8'd12: log_page_word = stat_data_units_written[31:0];
                        8'd13: log_page_word = stat_data_units_written[63:32];
                        8'd16: log_page_word = stat_host_read_cmds[31:0];
                        8'd17: log_page_word = stat_host_read_cmds[63:32];
                        8'd20: log_page_word = stat_host_write_cmds[31:0];
                        8'd21: log_page_word = stat_host_write_cmds[63:32];
                        8'd24: log_page_word = stat_cmds_completed[31:0];
                        8'd25: log_page_word = stat_cmds_completed[63:32];
                        8'd28: log_page_word = power_cycle_count;
                        8'd32: log_page_word = power_on_hours;
                        8'd36: log_page_word = stat_unsafe_shutdowns;
                        8'd40: log_page_word = stat_media_errors;
                        8'd44: log_page_word = stat_error_log_entries;
                        8'd48: log_page_word = warning_temp_time;
                        8'd49: log_page_word = critical_temp_time;
                        8'd50: log_page_word = {smart_temp_k, smart_temp_k};
                        8'd51: log_page_word = {16'h0000, smart_temp_k};
                        default: log_page_word = 32'h00000000;
                    endcase
                end
                LOG_PAGE_FW_SLOT: begin
                    case (dw_index[7:0])
                        8'd0: log_page_word = 32'h00000001;
                        8'd2: log_page_word = 32'h{{ if .NVMeIdentify }}{{ hex02 (index .NVMeIdentify.Controller 67) }}{{ hex02 (index .NVMeIdentify.Controller 66) }}{{ hex02 (index .NVMeIdentify.Controller 65) }}{{ hex02 (index .NVMeIdentify.Controller 64) }}{{ else }}20202020{{ end }}; // "DNV1" little-endian.
                        8'd3: log_page_word = 32'h{{ if .NVMeIdentify }}{{ hex02 (index .NVMeIdentify.Controller 71) }}{{ hex02 (index .NVMeIdentify.Controller 70) }}{{ hex02 (index .NVMeIdentify.Controller 69) }}{{ hex02 (index .NVMeIdentify.Controller 68) }}{{ else }}20202020{{ end }}; // ".000" little-endian-ish filler.
                        default: log_page_word = 32'h00000000;
                    endcase
                end
                LOG_PAGE_VENDOR: begin
                    case (dw_index[7:0])
                        8'd0: log_page_word = 32'h444D564E; // "NVMD".
                        8'd1: log_page_word = 32'h00000002; // format version 2.
                        8'd2: log_page_word = 32'h{{ if gt .NVMeAdvertisedLBAs 0 }}{{ lo32 .NVMeAdvertisedLBAs }}{{ else }}7730B0F0{{ end }};
                        8'd3: log_page_word = {8'h00, 8'h20, 8'h00, 8'h20}; // PRP/list profile, 32 KiB MDTS.
                        8'd4: log_page_word = 32'h00002000; // MAX_XFER_DW.
                        8'd5: log_page_word = 32'h00000000; // DMA timeout profile.
                        8'd6: log_page_word = 32'h00000000; // clock profile low.
                        8'd7: log_page_word = 32'h00000000; // clock profile high.
                        8'd8: log_page_word = stat_dma_mrd_tlps[31:0];
                        8'd9: log_page_word = stat_dma_mrd_tlps[63:32];
                        8'd10: log_page_word = stat_dma_mwr_tlps[31:0];
                        8'd11: log_page_word = stat_dma_mwr_tlps[63:32];
                        8'd12: log_page_word = stat_prp_list_fetches[31:0];
                        8'd13: log_page_word = stat_prp_list_fetches[63:32];
                        8'd14: log_page_word = stat_queue_resets[31:0];
                        8'd15: log_page_word = stat_queue_resets[63:32];
                        8'd16: log_page_word = stat_shutdowns[31:0];
                        8'd17: log_page_word = stat_shutdowns[63:32];
                        8'd18: log_page_word = stat_flush_cmds[31:0];
                        8'd19: log_page_word = stat_flush_cmds[63:32];
                        8'd20: log_page_word = stat_dataset_cmds[31:0];
                        8'd21: log_page_word = stat_dataset_cmds[63:32];
                        8'd22: log_page_word = stat_write_zero_cmds[31:0];
                        8'd23: log_page_word = stat_write_zero_cmds[63:32];
                        8'd24: log_page_word = 32'h00000000; // format count.
                        8'd25: log_page_word = 32'h00000000;
                        8'd26: log_page_word = 32'h00000000; // backend evictions.
                        8'd27: log_page_word = 32'h00000000;
                        8'd28: log_page_word = stat_timeout_errors[31:0];
                        8'd29: log_page_word = stat_timeout_errors[63:32];
                        8'd30: log_page_word = stat_cpl_errors[31:0];
                        8'd31: log_page_word = stat_cpl_errors[63:32];
                        8'd32: log_page_word = stat_invalid_cmds;
                        8'd33: log_page_word = stat_media_errors;
                        8'd34: log_page_word = 32'h00000000; // transport profile.
                        8'd35: log_page_word = stat_unsafe_shutdowns;
                        8'd36: log_page_word = 32'h00000000;
                        8'd37: log_page_word = stat_transport_errors[31:0];
                        8'd38: log_page_word = stat_transport_errors[63:32];
                        8'd39: log_page_word = 32'h00000000; // AER pending limit.
                        8'd40: log_page_word = {30'h0, aer_event_pending, aer_registered};
                        8'd41: log_page_word = {15'h0, 1'b1, io_vector};
                        8'd42: log_page_word = 32'h00000001; // one I/O queue pair.
                        8'd43: log_page_word = {24'h0, feat_async_event_cfg[7:0]};
                        8'd44: log_page_word = power_cycle_count;
                        8'd45: log_page_word = {31'h0, feat_write_cache[0]};
                        default: log_page_word = 32'h00000000;
                    endcase
                end
                default: log_page_word = 32'h00000000;
            endcase
        end
    endfunction

    reg         cc_en_prev;
    reg [1:0]   cc_shn_prev;
    // CC is the single source of truth. The write strobes arrive ahead of the
    // registered CC edge and must not reset queues or count a stop twice.
    wire        cc_start_event = cc_en && !cc_en_prev;
    wire        cc_stop_event  = !cc_en && cc_en_prev;
    wire        cc_reset_event = cc_start_event || cc_stop_event;
    wire        _unused_cc_write_strobes = cc_enable_wr ^ cc_disable_wr;
    wire        normal_shutdown_requested = (cc_shn == 2'b01);
    wire        normal_shutdown_start = normal_shutdown_requested &&
                                        (cc_shn_prev != 2'b01);
    wire        abrupt_shutdown_requested = cc_shn[1];
    wire        abrupt_shutdown_start = abrupt_shutdown_requested && !cc_shn_prev[1];
    reg         shutdown_flush_issued;
    reg         normal_shutdown_complete_epoch;
    reg         controller_fatal_latched;
    assign dma_cancel = abrupt_shutdown_requested;
    reg         aer_registered;
    reg [15:0]  aer_cid;
    reg         aer_event_pending;
    reg [31:0]  aer_event_info;
    reg [31:0]  num_queues_granted;
    reg [31:0]  feat_arbitration;
    reg [31:0]  feat_power_mgmt;
    reg [31:0]  feat_temp_threshold;
    reg [31:0]  feat_write_cache;
    reg [31:0]  feat_irq_coalescing;
    reg [31:0]  feat_async_event_cfg;

    reg [1:0]   io_dir;
    reg [63:0]  io_slba;
    reg [23:0]  io_total_dw;
    reg [23:0]  io_dw_idx;
    reg [31:0]  io_host_data;
    reg [63:0]  io_host_addr;
    reg [31:0]  prp_entry_lo;
    reg [31:0]  prp_entry_hi;
    reg         prp_cached_valid;
    reg [19:0]  prp_cached_index;
    reg [63:0]  prp_cached_base;
    reg [7:0]   dsm_range_idx;
    reg [7:0]   dsm_range_last;
    reg [1:0]   dsm_dw_idx;
    reg [31:0]  dsm_dw0;
    reg [31:0]  dsm_dw1;
    reg [31:0]  dsm_dw2;
    reg [31:0]  dsm_dw3;

    wire [31:0] io_prp_byte_off = {6'h00, io_dw_idx, 2'b00};
    wire [31:0] io_prp_first_span = 32'd4096 - {20'h00000, cmd_prp1[11:0]};
    wire [31:0] io_prp_after_first = io_prp_byte_off - io_prp_first_span;
    wire [31:0] io_prp_total_bytes = {6'h00, io_total_dw, 2'b00};
    wire        io_prp_after_first_page = (io_prp_byte_off >= io_prp_first_span);
    wire        io_prp2_required = (io_prp_total_bytes > io_prp_first_span);
    wire        io_prp_uses_list = (io_prp_total_bytes > (io_prp_first_span + 32'd4096));
    wire [19:0] io_prp_list_index = io_prp_after_first[31:12];
    wire [63:0] io_prp_list_entry_addr = cmd_prp2 + {41'h0, io_prp_list_index, 3'b000};
    wire [31:0] prp_entry_hi_value = dma_rd_valid ? dma_rd_data : prp_entry_hi;
    wire [63:0] prp_list_entry_value = {prp_entry_hi_value, prp_entry_lo};
    wire [63:0] prp_list_page_base = {prp_entry_hi_value, prp_entry_lo[31:12], 12'h000};
    wire        io_prp1_invalid = (io_total_dw == 24'h0) ||
                                  (cmd_prp1 == 64'h0000000000000000) ||
                                  (cmd_prp1[1:0] != 2'b00);
    wire        io_prp2_invalid = io_prp2_required &&
                                  ((cmd_prp2 == 64'h0000000000000000) ||
                                   (cmd_prp2[11:0] != 12'h000));
    wire        prp_list_entry_invalid = (prp_list_entry_value == 64'h0000000000000000) ||
                                         (prp_list_entry_value[11:0] != 12'h000);
    wire [31:0] dsm_dw3_value = dma_rd_valid ? dma_rd_data : dsm_dw3;
    wire [63:0] dsm_lba_value = {dsm_dw3_value, dsm_dw2};
    wire [63:0] dsm_nlb64 = {32'h00000000, dsm_dw1};
    wire [7:0]  dsm_range_next = dsm_range_idx + 8'd1;
    wire [7:0]  timing_dsm_ranges = cmd_cdw10[7:0] + 8'd1;
    wire        dsm_range_ok =
        (dsm_dw1 != 32'h00000000) &&
        (dsm_lba_value < NVME_ADVERTISED_LBAS) &&
        (dsm_nlb64 <= (NVME_ADVERTISED_LBAS - dsm_lba_value));

    wire [63:0] io_disk_lba    = io_slba + {47'h0, io_dw_idx[23:7]};
    wire [6:0]  io_disk_word   = io_dw_idx[6:0];
    wire        io_last_dw     = ((io_dw_idx + 24'd1) >= io_total_dw);
    wire [3:0]  timing_completion_class =
        (cqe_status != 15'h0000) ? TIMING_ERROR :
        (timing_class == TIMING_READ_PENDING) ?
            (timing_read_seen_miss ? TIMING_READ_MISS_ZERO : TIMING_READ_HIT) :
        timing_class;
    wire [31:0] dbg_timing_info = {
        timing_saturated,
        timing_effective_class,
        timing_wait_cycles[26:0]
    };
    wire [31:0] dbg_io_progress = {cqe_status[7:0], io_dir[1:0], io_last_dw, io_dw_idx[20:0]};
    wire [31:0] dbg_io_cmd_info =
        (state == S_DECODE_CMD) ? cmd_slba[31:0] :
                                  dbg_io_progress;
    // A command fetch must deliver exactly one 16-DWORD SQE. The legacy DMA
    // interface has no typed error output, so a short terminal read is the
    // fatal transport indication available to this responder.
    wire controller_fatal_event =
        ((state == S_FETCH_SQE) && dma_rd_done &&
         (!dma_rd_valid || (sqe_dw_idx != 4'd15))) ||
        ((state == S_SHUTDOWN) && normal_shutdown_requested &&
         disk_req_done && disk_error);
    assign controller_fatal = controller_fatal_latched || controller_fatal_event;
    assign dbg_cmd_info = ((state == S_TIMING_PREP) ||
                           (state == S_TIMING_EVAL) ||
                           (state == S_TIMING_DELAY)) ? dbg_timing_info :
                          active_io ? dbg_io_cmd_info :
                           {cqe_status[7:0], identify_cns, cmd_nsid[7:0], data_dw_cnt[7:0]};

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            state              <= S_IDLE;
            return_state       <= S_IDLE;
            active_qid         <= 16'h0000;

            sq_tail            <= 16'h0;
            sq_head            <= 16'h0;
            cq_tail            <= 16'h0;
            cq_head_db         <= 16'h0;
            cq_phase           <= 1'b1;
            admin_aqa          <= 32'h0;
            admin_asq_lo       <= 32'h0;
            admin_asq_hi       <= 32'h0;
            admin_acq_lo       <= 32'h0;
            admin_acq_hi       <= 32'h0;

            io_sq_created      <= 1'b0;
            io_cq_created      <= 1'b0;
            io_sq_base         <= 64'h0;
            io_cq_base         <= 64'h0;
            io_sq_last         <= 16'h0;
            io_cq_last         <= 16'h0;
            io_sq_tail         <= 16'h0;
            io_sq_head         <= 16'h0;
            io_cq_tail         <= 16'h0;
            io_cq_head_db      <= 16'h0;
            io_cq_phase        <= 1'b1;
            io_vector          <= 16'h0;

            dma_rd_req         <= 1'b0;
            dma_rd_addr        <= 64'h0;
            dma_rd_len         <= 10'h0;
            dma_wr_req         <= 1'b0;
            dma_wr_addr        <= 64'h0;
            dma_wr_data        <= 32'h0;
            dma_wr_be          <= 4'hF;
            dma_wr_valid       <= 1'b0;
            irq_delivery_done  <= 1'b0;
            disk_req_valid     <= 1'b0;
            disk_req_write     <= 1'b0;
            disk_req_flush     <= 1'b0;
            disk_req_lba       <= 64'h0;
            disk_req_word      <= 7'h0;
            disk_req_wdata     <= 32'h0;
            msix_trigger       <= 1'b0;
            pba_set_valid      <= 1'b0;
            pba_set_vector     <= 16'h0;

            sqe_dw_idx         <= 4'h0;
            cqe_dw_idx         <= 2'h0;
            cqe_result         <= 32'h0;
            cqe_status         <= 15'h0;
            last_error_count   <= 64'h0;
            last_error_sqid    <= 16'h0;
            last_error_cid     <= 16'h0;
            last_error_status  <= 16'h0;
            last_error_peloc   <= 16'h0;
            last_error_lba     <= 64'h0;
            last_error_nsid    <= 32'h0;
            timing_class       <= TIMING_ADMIN_SHORT;
            timing_effective_class <= TIMING_ADMIN_SHORT;
            timing_done_for_cmd <= 1'b0;
            timing_cmd_active  <= 1'b0;
            timing_saturated   <= 1'b0;
            timing_read_seen_hit <= 1'b0;
            timing_read_seen_miss <= 1'b0;
            timing_lfsr        <= 16'hACE1;
            timing_jitter_sample <= 16'h0000;
            timing_elapsed_cycles <= 32'h00000000;
            timing_target_cycles <= 32'h00000000;
            timing_wait_cycles <= 32'h00000000;
            data_dw_cnt        <= 11'h0;
            id_rom_offset      <= 13'h0;
            id_rom_addr        <= 13'h0;
            cc_en_prev         <= 1'b0;
            cc_shn_prev        <= 2'b00;
            shutdown_complete  <= 1'b0;
            shutdown_flush_issued <= 1'b0;
            normal_shutdown_complete_epoch <= 1'b0;
            controller_fatal_latched <= 1'b0;
            aer_registered     <= 1'b0;
            aer_cid            <= 16'h0000;
            aer_event_pending  <= 1'b0;
            aer_event_info     <= 32'h00000000;
            num_queues_granted <= 32'h00000000;
            feat_arbitration   <= 32'h00000000;
            feat_power_mgmt    <= 32'h00000000;
            feat_temp_threshold <= 32'h00000157;
            feat_write_cache   <= 32'h00000001;
            feat_irq_coalescing <= 32'h00000000;
            feat_async_event_cfg <= 32'h00000000;

            io_dir             <= IO_DIR_READ;
            io_slba            <= 64'h0;
            io_total_dw        <= 24'h0;
            io_dw_idx          <= 24'h0;
            io_host_data       <= 32'h0;
            io_host_addr       <= 64'h0;
            prp_entry_lo       <= 32'h0;
            prp_entry_hi       <= 32'h0;
            prp_cached_valid   <= 1'b0;
            prp_cached_index   <= 20'h0;
            prp_cached_base    <= 64'h0;
            dsm_range_idx      <= 8'h0;
            dsm_range_last     <= 8'h0;
            dsm_dw_idx         <= 2'h0;
            dsm_dw0            <= 32'h0;
            dsm_dw1            <= 32'h0;
            dsm_dw2            <= 32'h0;
            dsm_dw3            <= 32'h0;

            stat_data_units_read    <= 64'h{{ hex16 .NVMeSMART.DataUnitsRead }};
            stat_data_units_written <= 64'h{{ hex16 .NVMeSMART.DataUnitsWritten }};
            stat_host_read_cmds     <= 64'h{{ hex16 .NVMeSMART.HostReadCommands }};
            stat_host_write_cmds    <= 64'h{{ hex16 .NVMeSMART.HostWriteCommands }};
            stat_flush_cmds         <= 64'h0;
            stat_write_zero_cmds    <= 64'h0;
            stat_dataset_cmds       <= 64'h0;
            stat_cmds_completed     <= 64'h{{ hex16 .NVMeSMART.ControllerBusyMin }};
            stat_media_errors       <= 32'h{{ hex08 .NVMeSMART.MediaErrors }};
            stat_error_log_entries  <= 32'h{{ hex08 .NVMeSMART.ErrorLogEntries }};
            stat_unsafe_shutdowns   <= 32'h{{ hex08 .NVMeSMART.UnsafeShutdowns }};
            stat_dma_mrd_tlps       <= 64'h0;
            stat_dma_mwr_tlps       <= 64'h0;
            stat_prp_list_fetches   <= 64'h0;
            stat_queue_resets       <= 64'h0;
            stat_shutdowns          <= 64'h0;
            stat_timeout_errors     <= 64'h0;
            stat_cpl_errors         <= 64'h0;
            stat_invalid_cmds       <= 32'h0;
            stat_transport_errors   <= 64'h0;
            stat_aer_events         <= 64'h0;
            power_cycle_count       <= 32'h{{ hex08 .NVMeSMART.PowerCycles }};
            power_on_hours          <= 32'h{{ hex08 .NVMeSMART.PowerOnHours }};
            hour_second_count       <= 12'h0;
            second_tick             <= 27'h0;
            thermal_load            <= 8'h08;
            warning_temp_time       <= 32'h0;
            critical_temp_time      <= 32'h0;
        end else begin
            if (dma_rd_req)
                stat_dma_mrd_tlps <= stat_dma_mrd_tlps + 1'b1;
            if (dma_wr_req)
                stat_dma_mwr_tlps <= stat_dma_mwr_tlps + 1'b1;
            dma_rd_req     <= 1'b0;
            dma_wr_req     <= 1'b0;
            dma_wr_valid   <= 1'b0;
            disk_req_valid <= 1'b0;
            msix_trigger   <= 1'b0;
            irq_delivery_done <= 1'b0;
            pba_set_valid  <= 1'b0;
            if (timing_cmd_active && (timing_elapsed_cycles != 32'hFFFFFFFF))
                timing_elapsed_cycles <= timing_elapsed_cycles + 1'b1;

            if (cc_en) begin
                if (second_tick >= 27'd124999999) begin
                    second_tick <= 27'h0;
                    thermal_load <= (thermal_load == 8'h00) ? 8'h00 : (thermal_load - 1'b1);
                    if ((smart_temp_k >= 16'd343) && (warning_temp_time != 32'hFFFFFFFF))
                        warning_temp_time <= warning_temp_time + 1'b1;
                    if ((smart_temp_k >= 16'd358) && (critical_temp_time != 32'hFFFFFFFF))
                        critical_temp_time <= critical_temp_time + 1'b1;
                    if (hour_second_count >= 12'd3599) begin
                        hour_second_count <= 12'h0;
                        power_on_hours <= power_on_hours + 1'b1;
                    end else begin
                        hour_second_count <= hour_second_count + 1'b1;
                    end
                end else begin
                    second_tick <= second_tick + 1'b1;
                end
            end

            cc_en_prev <= cc_en;
            cc_shn_prev <= cc_shn;
            if (controller_fatal_event)
                controller_fatal_latched <= 1'b1;
            if (normal_shutdown_start)
                normal_shutdown_complete_epoch <= 1'b0;
            if (cc_shn == 2'b00) begin
                shutdown_complete <= 1'b0;
                shutdown_flush_issued <= 1'b0;
            end

            if (cc_en && !controller_fatal && doorbell_wr) begin
                if (doorbell_qid == 16'h0000) begin
                    if (doorbell_is_cq) begin
                        if (doorbell_val <= acq_last)
                            cq_head_db <= doorbell_val;
                        else if (acq_power2_entries)
                            cq_head_db <= doorbell_val & acq_last;
                    end else if (cc_shn == 2'b00) begin
                        normal_shutdown_complete_epoch <= 1'b0;
                        if (doorbell_val <= asq_last)
                            sq_tail <= doorbell_val;
                        else if (asq_power2_entries)
                            sq_tail <= doorbell_val & asq_last;
                    end
                end else if (doorbell_qid == 16'h0001) begin
                    if (doorbell_is_cq) begin
                        if (doorbell_val <= io_cq_last)
                            io_cq_head_db <= doorbell_val;
                        else if (io_cq_power2_entries)
                            io_cq_head_db <= doorbell_val & io_cq_last;
                    end else if (cc_shn == 2'b00) begin
                        normal_shutdown_complete_epoch <= 1'b0;
                        if (doorbell_val <= io_sq_last)
                            io_sq_tail <= doorbell_val;
                        else if (io_sq_power2_entries)
                            io_sq_tail <= doorbell_val & io_sq_last;
                    end
                end
            end

            if (cc_reset_event) begin
                stat_queue_resets <= stat_queue_resets + 1'b1;
                shutdown_complete <= 1'b0;
                shutdown_flush_issued <= 1'b0;
                normal_shutdown_complete_epoch <= 1'b0;
                controller_fatal_latched <= 1'b0;
                if (cc_stop_event)
                    stat_shutdowns <= stat_shutdowns + 1'b1;
                state              <= S_IDLE;
                return_state       <= S_IDLE;
                active_qid         <= 16'h0000;

                sq_tail            <= 16'h0;
                sq_head            <= 16'h0;
                cq_tail            <= 16'h0;
                cq_head_db         <= 16'h0;
                cq_phase           <= 1'b1;
                if (cc_start_event) begin
                    admin_aqa    <= aqa;
                    admin_asq_lo <= asq_lo;
                    admin_asq_hi <= asq_hi;
                    admin_acq_lo <= acq_lo;
                    admin_acq_hi <= acq_hi;
                end else begin
                    admin_aqa    <= 32'h0;
                    admin_asq_lo <= 32'h0;
                    admin_asq_hi <= 32'h0;
                    admin_acq_lo <= 32'h0;
                    admin_acq_hi <= 32'h0;
                end

                io_sq_created      <= 1'b0;
                io_cq_created      <= 1'b0;
                io_sq_base         <= 64'h0;
                io_cq_base         <= 64'h0;
                io_sq_last         <= 16'h0;
                io_cq_last         <= 16'h0;
                io_sq_tail         <= 16'h0;
                io_sq_head         <= 16'h0;
                io_cq_tail         <= 16'h0;
                io_cq_head_db      <= 16'h0;
                io_cq_phase        <= 1'b1;
                io_vector          <= 16'h0;

                sqe_dw_idx         <= 4'h0;
                cqe_dw_idx         <= 2'h0;
                cqe_result         <= 32'h0;
                cqe_status         <= 15'h0;
                last_error_count   <= 64'h0;
                last_error_sqid    <= 16'h0;
                last_error_cid     <= 16'h0;
                last_error_status  <= 16'h0;
                last_error_peloc   <= 16'h0;
                last_error_lba     <= 64'h0;
                last_error_nsid    <= 32'h0;
                timing_class       <= TIMING_ADMIN_SHORT;
                timing_effective_class <= TIMING_ADMIN_SHORT;
                timing_done_for_cmd <= 1'b0;
                timing_cmd_active  <= 1'b0;
                timing_saturated   <= 1'b0;
                timing_read_seen_hit <= 1'b0;
                timing_read_seen_miss <= 1'b0;
                timing_jitter_sample <= 16'h0000;
                timing_elapsed_cycles <= 32'h00000000;
                timing_target_cycles <= 32'h00000000;
                timing_wait_cycles <= 32'h00000000;
                data_dw_cnt        <= 11'h0;
                id_rom_offset      <= 13'h0;
                id_rom_addr        <= 13'h0;
                aer_registered     <= 1'b0;
                aer_cid            <= 16'h0000;
                aer_event_pending  <= 1'b0;
                aer_event_info     <= 32'h00000000;
                num_queues_granted <= 32'h00000000;

                io_dir             <= IO_DIR_READ;
                io_slba            <= 64'h0;
                io_total_dw        <= 24'h0;
                io_dw_idx          <= 24'h0;
                io_host_data       <= 32'h0;
                io_host_addr       <= 64'h0;
                prp_entry_lo       <= 32'h0;
                prp_entry_hi       <= 32'h0;
                prp_cached_valid   <= 1'b0;
                prp_cached_index   <= 20'h0;
                prp_cached_base    <= 64'h0;
                dsm_range_idx      <= 8'h0;
                dsm_range_last     <= 8'h0;
                dsm_dw_idx         <= 2'h0;
                dsm_dw0            <= 32'h0;
                dsm_dw1            <= 32'h0;
                dsm_dw2            <= 32'h0;
                dsm_dw3            <= 32'h0;
                warning_temp_time  <= 32'h0;
                critical_temp_time <= 32'h0;
                feat_arbitration   <= 32'h00000000;
                feat_power_mgmt    <= 32'h00000000;
                feat_temp_threshold <= 32'h00000157;
                feat_write_cache   <= 32'h00000001;
                feat_irq_coalescing <= 32'h00000000;
                feat_async_event_cfg <= 32'h00000000;
                if (cc_stop_event && !normal_shutdown_complete_epoch)
                    stat_unsafe_shutdowns <= stat_unsafe_shutdowns + 1'b1;
            end else if (controller_fatal_latched || controller_fatal_event) begin
                // Once CFS is raised, quiesce all command-side state until the
                // CC disable/reset edge clears both the responder and CSTS.
                state <= S_IDLE;
                return_state <= S_IDLE;
                timing_cmd_active <= 1'b0;
                timing_done_for_cmd <= 1'b0;
                disk_req_write <= 1'b0;
                disk_req_flush <= 1'b0;
                prp_cached_valid <= 1'b0;
            end else if (abrupt_shutdown_start) begin
                // Cancel outstanding host reads and discard reversible command
                // state. Already accepted backend work reaches its own terminal
                // indication before SHST advances.
                shutdown_complete <= 1'b0;
                shutdown_flush_issued <= 1'b0;
                disk_req_write <= 1'b0;
                disk_req_flush <= 1'b0;
                timing_cmd_active <= 1'b0;
                timing_done_for_cmd <= 1'b0;
                prp_cached_valid <= 1'b0;
                aer_registered <= 1'b0;
                aer_event_pending <= 1'b0;
                state <= S_SHUTDOWN;
                return_state <= S_IDLE;
            end else if (!dma_enabled) begin
                state <= S_IDLE;
                return_state <= S_IDLE;
                timing_cmd_active <= 1'b0;
                timing_done_for_cmd <= 1'b0;
            end else if (!cc_en && state != S_SHUTDOWN) begin
                state <= S_IDLE;
            end else begin
                case (state)
                    S_IDLE: begin
                        if (normal_shutdown_requested) begin
                            // Active work reaches IDLE only after its CQE and
                            // interrupt path have drained. Complete a real
                            // backend flush before acknowledging normal SHN.
                            disk_req_valid <= 1'b1;
                            disk_req_write <= 1'b0;
                            disk_req_flush <= 1'b1;
                            disk_req_lba <= 64'h0000000000000000;
                            disk_req_word <= 7'h00;
                            shutdown_flush_issued <= 1'b1;
                            state <= S_SHUTDOWN;
                        end else if (abrupt_shutdown_requested) begin
                            disk_req_write <= 1'b0;
                            disk_req_flush <= 1'b0;
                            state <= S_SHUTDOWN;
                        end else if (aer_registered && aer_event_pending) begin
                            cqe[0] <= aer_event_info;
                            cqe[1] <= 32'h00000000;
                            cqe[2] <= {16'h0000, sq_head};
                            cqe[3] <= {15'h0000, cq_phase, aer_cid};
                            cqe_dw_idx <= 2'h0;
                            state <= S_AER_POST;
                        end else if (aer_registered && !aer_event_pending && (smart_warning_byte != 8'h00)) begin
                            aer_event_pending <= 1'b1;
                            aer_event_info <= 32'h00000002;
                            stat_aer_events <= stat_aer_events + 1'b1;
                        end else if (irq_delivery_valid && irq_delivery_ready) begin
                            dma_wr_req   <= 1'b1;
                            dma_wr_valid <= 1'b1;
                            dma_wr_addr  <= msix_vector_addr;
                            dma_wr_data  <= msix_vector_data;
                            dma_wr_be    <= 4'hF;
                            return_state <= S_IDLE;
                            state        <= S_WAIT_DMA_WR;
                        end else if ((sq_tail != sq_head) && admin_queue_config_valid) begin
                            active_qid  <= 16'h0000;
                            dma_rd_req  <= 1'b1;
                            dma_rd_addr <= asq_base + ({48'h0, sq_head} * 64);
                            dma_rd_len  <= 10'd16;
                            sqe_dw_idx  <= 4'h0;
                            timing_cmd_active <= 1'b1;
                            timing_done_for_cmd <= 1'b0;
                            timing_class <= TIMING_ADMIN_SHORT;
                            timing_read_seen_hit <= 1'b0;
                            timing_read_seen_miss <= 1'b0;
                            timing_elapsed_cycles <= 32'h00000000;
                            state       <= S_FETCH_SQE;
                        end else if (NVME_ENABLE_IO_QUEUES && io_sq_created && io_cq_created && (io_sq_tail != io_sq_head)) begin
                            active_qid  <= 16'h0001;
                            dma_rd_req  <= 1'b1;
                            dma_rd_addr <= io_sq_base + ({48'h0, io_sq_head} * 64);
                            dma_rd_len  <= 10'd16;
                            sqe_dw_idx  <= 4'h0;
                            timing_cmd_active <= 1'b1;
```
