```tmpl
                            timing_done_for_cmd <= 1'b0;
                            timing_class <= TIMING_ADMIN_SHORT;
                            timing_read_seen_hit <= 1'b0;
                            timing_read_seen_miss <= 1'b0;
                            timing_elapsed_cycles <= 32'h00000000;
                            state       <= S_FETCH_SQE;
                        end
                    end

                    S_FETCH_SQE: begin
                        if (dma_rd_valid) begin
                            sqe[sqe_dw_idx] <= dma_rd_data;
                            sqe_dw_idx <= sqe_dw_idx + 1'b1;
                        end
                        if (dma_rd_done)
                            state <= S_DECODE_CMD;
                    end

                    S_DECODE_CMD: begin
                        cqe_result <= 32'h00000000;
                        cqe_status <= 15'h0000;
                        timing_class <= TIMING_ADMIN_SHORT;
                        timing_read_seen_hit <= 1'b0;
                        timing_read_seen_miss <= 1'b0;
                        timing_jitter_sample <= timing_mix_lfsr(timing_lfsr, {active_qid[7:0], cmd_opcode, cmd_cid});
                        timing_lfsr <= timing_mix_lfsr(timing_lfsr, cmd_slba[31:0] ^ {active_qid, cmd_cid});

                        if (active_io && NVME_STUB_IO_DATA) begin
                            case (cmd_opcode)
                                8'h00,
                                8'h09: cqe_status <= 15'h0000;
                                default: cqe_status <= 15'h0001;
                            endcase
                            state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                        end else if (active_io) begin
                            case (cmd_opcode)
                                8'h00: begin
                                    timing_class <= TIMING_FLUSH;
                                    prp_cached_valid <= 1'b0;
                                    disk_req_valid <= 1'b1;
                                    disk_req_write <= 1'b0;
                                    disk_req_flush <= 1'b1;
                                    disk_req_lba   <= 64'h0;
                                    disk_req_word  <= 7'h0;
                                    stat_flush_cmds <= stat_flush_cmds + 1'b1;
                                    state <= S_IO_FLUSH_WAIT;
                                end
                                8'h01: begin
                                    timing_class <= TIMING_WRITE;
                                    if (NVME_ZERO_IO_READS) begin
                                        state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                    end else if (!cmd_mdts_ok) begin
                                        cqe_status <= NVME_SC_INVALID_FIELD;
                                        state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                    end else if (cmd_lba_ok) begin
                                        io_dir      <= IO_DIR_WRITE;
                                        io_slba     <= cmd_slba;
                                        io_total_dw <= cmd_total_dw;
                                        io_dw_idx   <= 24'h0;
                                        prp_cached_valid <= 1'b0;
                                        stat_host_write_cmds <= stat_host_write_cmds + 1'b1;
                                        stat_data_units_written <= stat_data_units_written + data_units_for_nlb(cmd_nlb_count);
                                        thermal_load <= (thermal_load == 8'hFF) ? 8'hFF : (thermal_load + 1'b1);
                                        return_state <= NVME_PRP_ONLY_IO ? S_IO_ADVANCE : S_IO_WRITE_DMA_REQ;
                                        state       <= S_RESOLVE_IO_PRP;
                                    end else begin
                                        cqe_status <= NVME_SC_LBA_RANGE;
                                        state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                    end
                                end
                                8'h02: begin
                                    timing_class <= (NVME_ZERO_IO_READS || NVME_PRP_ONLY_IO) ? TIMING_READ_MISS_ZERO : TIMING_READ_PENDING;
                                    if (!cmd_mdts_ok) begin
                                        cqe_status <= NVME_SC_INVALID_FIELD;
                                        state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                    end else if (cmd_lba_ok) begin
                                        io_dir      <= IO_DIR_READ;
                                        io_slba     <= cmd_slba;
                                        io_total_dw <= cmd_total_dw;
                                        io_dw_idx   <= 24'h0;
                                        prp_cached_valid <= 1'b0;
                                        stat_host_read_cmds <= stat_host_read_cmds + 1'b1;
                                        stat_data_units_read <= stat_data_units_read + data_units_for_nlb(cmd_nlb_count);
                                        thermal_load <= (thermal_load == 8'hFF) ? 8'hFF : (thermal_load + 1'b1);
                                        if (NVME_PRP_ONLY_IO) begin
                                            return_state <= S_IO_ADVANCE;
                                            state <= S_RESOLVE_IO_PRP;
                                        end else if (NVME_ZERO_IO_READS) begin
                                            io_host_data <= 32'h00000000;
                                            return_state <= S_IO_READ_HOST_WR;
                                            state <= S_RESOLVE_IO_PRP;
                                        end else begin
                                            state <= S_IO_READ_DISK_REQ;
                                        end
                                    end else begin
                                        cqe_status <= NVME_SC_LBA_RANGE;
                                        state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                    end
                                end
                                8'h08: begin
                                    timing_class <= TIMING_WRITE_ZEROES;
                                    if ((cmd_cdw12[31:16] != 16'h0000) ||
                                        (cmd_cdw13 != 32'h00000000) ||
                                        (cmd_cdw14 != 32'h00000000) ||
                                        (cmd_cdw15 != 32'h00000000)) begin
                                        cqe_status <= NVME_SC_INVALID_FIELD;
                                        state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                    end else if (!cmd_mdts_ok) begin
                                        cqe_status <= NVME_SC_INVALID_FIELD;
                                        state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                    end else if (cmd_lba_ok) begin
                                        io_dir      <= IO_DIR_ZERO;
                                        io_slba     <= cmd_slba;
                                        io_total_dw <= cmd_total_dw;
                                        io_dw_idx   <= 24'h0;
                                        prp_cached_valid <= 1'b0;
                                        stat_write_zero_cmds <= stat_write_zero_cmds + 1'b1;
                                        stat_data_units_written <= stat_data_units_written + data_units_for_nlb(cmd_nlb_count);
                                        disk_req_valid <= 1'b1;
                                        disk_req_write <= 1'b1;
                                        disk_req_flush <= 1'b1;
                                        disk_req_lba   <= cmd_slba;
                                        disk_req_word  <= 7'h0;
                                        disk_req_wdata <= {15'h0000, cmd_nlb_count};
                                        state          <= S_IO_FLUSH_WAIT;
                                    end else begin
                                        cqe_status <= NVME_SC_LBA_RANGE;
                                        state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                    end
                                end
                                8'h09: begin
                                    timing_class <= TIMING_DSM;
                                    stat_dataset_cmds <= stat_dataset_cmds + 1'b1;
                                    if (cmd_nsid != 32'd1) begin
                                        cqe_status <= NVME_SC_INVALID_NS;
                                        state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                    end else if (((cmd_cdw11 & 32'hFFFFFFFB) != 32'h00000000) ||
                                                 (cmd_cdw10[31:8] != 24'h000000)) begin
                                        cqe_status <= NVME_SC_INVALID_FIELD;
                                        state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                    end else if (cmd_cdw11[2]) begin
                                        // Deallocate: invalidate backing-cache slots in each range.
                                        io_total_dw    <= ({16'h0000, cmd_cdw10[7:0]} + 24'd1) << 2;
                                        io_dw_idx      <= 24'h0;
                                        dsm_range_idx  <= 8'h0;
                                        dsm_range_last <= cmd_cdw10[7:0];
                                        dsm_dw_idx     <= 2'h0;
                                        prp_cached_valid <= 1'b0;
                                        return_state   <= S_DSM_FETCH_REQ;
                                        state          <= S_RESOLVE_IO_PRP;
                                    end else begin
                                        // Advisory (no Deallocate): complete without mutating cache.
                                        state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                    end
                                end
                                default: begin
                                    // Unhandled IO opcode -> Invalid Command Opcode (SC=0x01).
                                    cqe_status <= 15'h0001;
                                    state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                end
                            endcase
                        end else begin
                            case (cmd_opcode)
                                8'h00: begin
                                    if (cmd_cdw10[15:0] == 16'h0001) begin
                                        io_sq_created <= 1'b0;
                                        io_sq_tail <= 16'h0;
                                        io_sq_head <= 16'h0;
                                    end
                                    state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                end

                                8'h01: begin
                                    if (!NVME_ENABLE_IO_QUEUES) begin
                                        cqe_status <= 15'h0001;
                                    end else if ((cmd_cdw10[15:0] == 16'h0001) &&
                                                 (cmd_cdw10[31:16] != 16'h0000) &&
                                                 (cmd_cdw11[0] == 1'b1) &&
                                                 (cmd_cdw11[31:16] == 16'h0001) &&
                                                 io_cq_created &&
                                                 cmd_prp1_page_valid) begin
                                        io_sq_base <= cmd_prp1 & 64'hFFFFFFFFFFFFF000;
                                        io_sq_last <= cmd_cdw10[31:16];
                                        io_sq_tail <= 16'h0;
                                        io_sq_head <= 16'h0;
                                        io_sq_created <= 1'b1;
                                    end else begin
                                        cqe_status <= 15'h0001;
                                    end
                                    state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                end

	                                8'h02: begin
                                    timing_class <= TIMING_GET_LOG;
	                                    case (cmd_cdw10[7:0])
                                        LOG_PAGE_SUPPORTED,
                                        LOG_PAGE_ERROR,
                                        LOG_PAGE_SMART,
                                        LOG_PAGE_FW_SLOT,
                                        LOG_PAGE_VENDOR: begin
                                            data_dw_cnt <= 11'h0;
                                            state <= S_EXEC_LOGPAGE;
                                        end
                                        default: begin
                                            cqe_status <= NVME_SC_INVALID_FIELD;
                                            state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                        end
                                    endcase
                                end

                                8'h04: begin
                                    if (cmd_cdw10[15:0] == 16'h0001) begin
                                        io_cq_created <= 1'b0;
                                        io_cq_tail <= 16'h0;
                                        io_cq_head_db <= 16'h0;
                                    end
                                    state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                end

                                8'h05: begin
                                    if (!NVME_ENABLE_IO_QUEUES) begin
                                        cqe_status <= 15'h0001;
                                    end else if ((cmd_cdw10[15:0] == 16'h0001) &&
                                                 (cmd_cdw10[31:16] != 16'h0000) &&
                                                 (cmd_cdw11[0] == 1'b1) &&
                                                 cmd_prp1_page_valid) begin
                                        io_cq_base <= cmd_prp1 & 64'hFFFFFFFFFFFFF000;
                                        io_cq_last <= cmd_cdw10[31:16];
                                        io_cq_tail <= 16'h0;
                                        io_cq_head_db <= 16'h0;
                                        io_cq_phase <= 1'b1;
                                        io_vector <= (cmd_cdw11[31:16] >= NVME_NUM_MSIX_VECTORS) ? 16'h0000 : cmd_cdw11[31:16];
                                        io_cq_created <= 1'b1;
                                    end else begin
                                        cqe_status <= 15'h0001;
                                    end
                                    state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                end

	                                8'h06: begin
                                    timing_class <= TIMING_IDENTIFY;
		                                    case (identify_cns)
	                                        8'h00,
	                                        8'h11: begin
	                                            if (cmd_nsid_selects_ns1) begin
	                                                id_rom_offset <= 13'h1000;
	                                                id_rom_addr <= 13'h1000;
	                                                data_dw_cnt <= 11'h0;
	                                                state <= S_EXEC_IDENTIFY;
	                                            end else begin
	                                                cqe_status <= NVME_SC_INVALID_NS;
	                                                state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
	                                            end
	                                        end
	                                        8'h01: begin
	                                            id_rom_offset <= 13'h0000;
	                                            id_rom_addr <= 13'h0000;
	                                            data_dw_cnt <= 11'h0;
	                                            state <= S_EXEC_IDENTIFY;
	                                        end
	                                        8'h02,
	                                        8'h10: begin
	                                            data_dw_cnt <= 11'h0;
	                                            state <= S_EXEC_NSLIST;
	                                        end
	                                        8'h03: begin
	                                            if (cmd_nsid_selects_ns1) begin
	                                                data_dw_cnt <= 11'h0;
	                                                state <= S_EXEC_NSID_DESC;
	                                            end else begin
	                                                cqe_status <= NVME_SC_INVALID_NS;
	                                                state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
	                                            end
	                                        end
	                                        default: begin
	                                            cqe_status <= NVME_SC_INVALID_FIELD;
	                                            state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
	                                        end
	                                    endcase
                                end

                                8'h08: begin
                                    state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                end

                                8'h09: begin
                                    case (cmd_cdw10[7:0])
                                        8'h01: feat_arbitration <= cmd_cdw11;
                                        8'h02: feat_power_mgmt <= cmd_cdw11;
                                        8'h04: feat_temp_threshold <= cmd_cdw11;
                                        8'h06: feat_write_cache <= cmd_cdw11;
                                        8'h07: begin
                                            num_queues_granted <= 32'h00000000;
                                            cqe_result <= 32'h00000000;
                                        end
                                        8'h08, 8'h09, 8'h0A: ; // minimal: accept without persisting
                                        8'h0B: feat_async_event_cfg <= cmd_cdw11;
                                        default: cqe_status <= NVME_SC_INVALID_FIELD;
                                    endcase
                                    state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                end

                                8'h0A: begin
                                    case (cmd_cdw10[7:0])
                                        8'h01: cqe_result <= feat_arbitration;
                                        8'h02: cqe_result <= feat_power_mgmt;
                                        8'h04: cqe_result <= feat_temp_threshold;
                                        8'h06: cqe_result <= feat_write_cache;
                                        8'h07: cqe_result <= num_queues_granted;
                                        8'h08: cqe_result <= feat_irq_coalescing;
                                        8'h09, 8'h0A: cqe_result <= 32'h00000000;
                                        8'h0B: cqe_result <= feat_async_event_cfg;
                                        default: cqe_status <= NVME_SC_INVALID_FIELD;
                                    endcase
                                    state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                end

	                                8'h0C: begin
	                                    if (aer_registered) begin
	                                        cqe_status <= NVME_SC_INVALID_FIELD;
	                                        state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
	                                    end else begin
	                                        aer_cid <= cmd_cid;
	                                        aer_registered <= 1'b1;
	                                        sq_head <= sq_head_next;
	                                        timing_cmd_active <= 1'b0;
	                                        state <= S_IDLE;
	                                    end
	                                end

	                                8'h80: begin
                                    timing_class <= TIMING_FORMAT;
	                                    if (!format_nvm_ok) begin
                                        cqe_status <= NVME_SC_INVALID_FORMAT;
                                        state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                    end else begin
                                        disk_req_valid <= 1'b1;
                                        disk_req_write <= 1'b1;
                                        disk_req_flush <= 1'b1;
                                        disk_req_lba   <= 64'h0;
                                        disk_req_word  <= 7'h0;
                                        disk_req_wdata <= 32'hFFFFFFFF;
                                        state <= S_FORMAT_CLEAR;
                                    end
                                end

                                default: begin
                                    // Unhandled admin opcode -> Invalid Command Opcode (SC=0x01).
                                    cqe_status <= 15'h0001;
                                    state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                end
                            endcase
                        end
                    end

                    S_EXEC_IDENTIFY: begin
                        if (data_dw_cnt == 11'h0) begin
                            id_rom_addr <= id_rom_offset + 13'h0004;
                            data_dw_cnt <= 11'h1;
                        end else begin
                            dma_wr_req   <= 1'b1;
                            dma_wr_valid <= 1'b1;
                            dma_wr_addr  <= prp_data_addr({13'h0, data_dw_cnt - 11'h1});
                            dma_wr_data  <= identify_data_word(id_rom_offset, data_dw_cnt - 11'h1, id_rom_data);
                            dma_wr_be    <= 4'hF;
                            if (data_dw_cnt >= 11'd1024)
                                return_state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                            else begin
                                if (data_dw_cnt < 11'd1023)
                                    id_rom_addr <= id_rom_offset + {data_dw_cnt + 11'h1, 2'b00};
                                data_dw_cnt <= data_dw_cnt + 1'b1;
                                return_state <= S_EXEC_IDENTIFY;
                            end
                            state <= S_WAIT_DMA_WR;
                        end
                    end

                    S_EXEC_NSLIST: begin
                        dma_wr_req   <= 1'b1;
                        dma_wr_valid <= 1'b1;
                        dma_wr_addr  <= prp_data_addr({13'h0, data_dw_cnt});
	                        dma_wr_data  <= ((data_dw_cnt == 11'h0) && cmd_nsid_lists_ns1) ? 32'h00000001 : 32'h00000000;
                        dma_wr_be    <= 4'hF;
                        if (data_dw_cnt >= 11'd1023)
                            return_state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                        else begin
                            data_dw_cnt <= data_dw_cnt + 1'b1;
                            return_state <= S_EXEC_NSLIST;
                        end
                        state <= S_WAIT_DMA_WR;
                    end

                    S_EXEC_ZERO4K: begin
                        dma_wr_req   <= 1'b1;
                        dma_wr_valid <= 1'b1;
                        dma_wr_addr  <= prp_data_addr({13'h0, data_dw_cnt});
                        dma_wr_data  <= 32'h00000000;
                        dma_wr_be    <= 4'hF;
                        if (data_dw_cnt >= 11'd1023)
                            return_state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                        else begin
                            data_dw_cnt <= data_dw_cnt + 1'b1;
                            return_state <= S_EXEC_ZERO4K;
                        end
                        state <= S_WAIT_DMA_WR;
                    end

                    S_EXEC_NSID_DESC: begin
                        dma_wr_req   <= 1'b1;
                        dma_wr_valid <= 1'b1;
                        dma_wr_addr  <= prp_data_addr({13'h0, data_dw_cnt});
                        dma_wr_be    <= 4'hF;
                        if (cmd_nsid_selects_ns1) begin
                            case (data_dw_cnt)
                                11'h000: dma_wr_data <= 32'h00001002; // NGUID descriptor: type=2, len=16
                                11'h001: dma_wr_data <= 32'hDDCC9ED1;
                                11'h002: dma_wr_data <= 32'hC24308EF;
                                11'h003: dma_wr_data <= 32'h25F2BB9D;
                                11'h004: dma_wr_data <= 32'h11BA97CE;
                                default: dma_wr_data <= 32'h00000000;
                            endcase
                        end else begin
                            dma_wr_data <= 32'h00000000;
                        end
                        if (data_dw_cnt >= 11'd1023)
                            return_state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                        else begin
                            data_dw_cnt <= data_dw_cnt + 1'b1;
                            return_state <= S_EXEC_NSID_DESC;
                        end
                        state <= S_WAIT_DMA_WR;
                    end

                    S_EXEC_LOGPAGE: begin
                        dma_wr_req   <= 1'b1;
                        dma_wr_valid <= 1'b1;
                        dma_wr_addr  <= prp_data_addr({13'h0, data_dw_cnt});
                        dma_wr_be    <= 4'hF;
                        dma_wr_data  <= log_page_word(data_dw_cnt);
                        if (data_dw_cnt >= cmd_log_last_dw)
                            return_state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                        else begin
                            data_dw_cnt <= data_dw_cnt + 1'b1;
                            return_state <= S_EXEC_LOGPAGE;
                        end
                        state <= S_WAIT_DMA_WR;
                    end

                    S_BUILD_CQE: begin
                        if (NVME_TIMING_ENABLE && !timing_done_for_cmd) begin
                            state <= S_TIMING_PREP;
                        end else begin
                            if (cqe_status != 15'h0000) begin
                                stat_error_log_entries <= stat_error_log_entries + 1'b1;
                                last_error_count <= {32'h00000000, stat_error_log_entries + 1'b1};
                                last_error_sqid <= active_qid;
                                last_error_cid <= cmd_cid;
                                last_error_status <= {cqe_status, 1'b0};
                                last_error_peloc <= 16'h0000;
                                last_error_lba <= (active_qid == 16'h0000) ? 64'h0000000000000000 : cmd_slba;
                                last_error_nsid <= cmd_nsid;
                            end
                            cqe[0] <= cqe_result;
                            cqe[1] <= 32'h00000000;
                            cqe[2] <= {active_qid, active_sq_head_next};
                            cqe[3] <= {cqe_status, active_cq_phase, cmd_cid};
                            cqe_dw_idx <= 2'h0;
                            state <= S_POST_CQE;
                        end
                    end

                    S_TIMING_PREP: begin
                        timing_done_for_cmd <= 1'b1;
                        timing_effective_class <= timing_completion_class;
                        timing_target_cycles <= timing_profile_cycles(
                            timing_completion_class,
                            cmd_nlb_count,
                            timing_dsm_ranges,
                            timing_jitter_sample
                        );
                        state <= S_TIMING_EVAL;
                    end

                    S_TIMING_EVAL: begin
                        if (timing_target_cycles > timing_elapsed_cycles) begin
                            timing_wait_cycles <= timing_target_cycles - timing_elapsed_cycles;
                            timing_saturated <= 1'b0;
                            state <= S_TIMING_DELAY;
                        end else begin
                            timing_wait_cycles <= 32'h00000000;
                            timing_saturated <= 1'b1;
                            state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                        end
                    end

                    S_TIMING_DELAY: begin
                        if (timing_wait_cycles <= 32'd1) begin
                            timing_wait_cycles <= 32'h00000000;
                            state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                        end else begin
                            timing_wait_cycles <= timing_wait_cycles - 32'd1;
                        end
                    end

                    S_POST_CQE: begin
                        dma_wr_req   <= 1'b1;
                        dma_wr_valid <= 1'b1;
                        dma_wr_addr  <= active_cq_base + active_cq_offset +
                                        {62'h0, cqe_dw_idx, 2'b00};
                        dma_wr_data  <= cqe[cqe_dw_idx];
                        dma_wr_be    <= 4'hF;

                        if (cqe_dw_idx == 2'd3) begin
                            cqe_dw_idx <= 2'h0;
                            return_state <= S_SEND_MSIX;
                        end else begin
                            cqe_dw_idx <= cqe_dw_idx + 1'b1;
                            return_state <= S_POST_CQE;
                        end
                        state <= S_WAIT_DMA_WR;
                    end

                    S_AER_POST: begin
                        dma_wr_req   <= 1'b1;
                        dma_wr_valid <= 1'b1;
                        dma_wr_addr  <= acq_base + admin_cq_offset +
                                        {62'h0, cqe_dw_idx, 2'b00};
                        dma_wr_data  <= cqe[cqe_dw_idx];
                        dma_wr_be    <= 4'hF;

                        if (cqe_dw_idx == 2'd3) begin
                            cqe_dw_idx <= 2'h0;
                            return_state <= S_AER_FINISH;
                        end else begin
                            cqe_dw_idx <= cqe_dw_idx + 1'b1;
                            return_state <= S_AER_POST;
                        end
                        state <= S_WAIT_DMA_WR;
                    end

                    S_AER_FINISH: begin
                        aer_registered    <= 1'b0;
                        aer_event_pending <= 1'b0;
                        if (cq_tail >= acq_last) begin
                            cq_tail  <= 16'h0;
                            cq_phase <= ~cq_phase;
                        end else begin
                            cq_tail  <= cq_tail_next;
                        end
                        pba_set_valid  <= 1'b1;
                        pba_set_vector <= 16'h0000;
                        state <= S_IDLE;
                    end

                    S_SEND_MSIX: begin
                        stat_cmds_completed <= stat_cmds_completed + 1'b1;
                        timing_cmd_active <= 1'b0;
                        if (active_io) begin
                            io_sq_head <= io_sq_head_next;
                            if (io_cq_tail >= io_cq_last) begin
                                io_cq_tail <= 16'h0;
                                io_cq_phase <= ~io_cq_phase;
                            end else begin
                                io_cq_tail <= io_cq_tail_next;
                            end
                        end else begin
                            sq_head <= sq_head_next;
                            if (cq_tail >= acq_last) begin
                                cq_tail <= 16'h0;
                                cq_phase <= ~cq_phase;
                            end else begin
                                cq_tail <= cq_tail_next;
                            end
                        end

                        pba_set_valid  <= 1'b1;
                        pba_set_vector <= active_io ? io_vector : 16'h0000;
                        state <= S_IDLE;
                    end

                    S_WAIT_DMA_WR: begin
                        if (dma_wr_done) begin
                            if (return_state == S_IDLE)
                                irq_delivery_done <= 1'b1;
                            state <= return_state;
                        end
                    end

                    S_RESOLVE_IO_PRP: begin
	                        if (io_prp1_invalid || io_prp2_invalid) begin
	                            cqe_status <= NVME_SC_PRP_OFFSET_INVALID;
	                            state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
	                        end else if (!io_prp_after_first_page) begin
	                            io_host_addr <= cmd_prp1 + {32'h00000000, io_prp_byte_off};
	                            state <= return_state;
	                        end else if (!io_prp_uses_list) begin
	                            io_host_addr <= cmd_prp2 + {32'h00000000, io_prp_after_first};
	                            state <= return_state;
                        end else if (prp_cached_valid && (prp_cached_index == io_prp_list_index)) begin
                            io_host_addr <= prp_cached_base + {52'h0000000000000, io_prp_after_first[11:0]};
                            state <= return_state;
                        end else begin
                            dma_rd_req  <= 1'b1;
                            dma_rd_addr <= io_prp_list_entry_addr;
                            dma_rd_len  <= 10'd1;
                            state <= S_PRP_LIST_RD_LO;
                        end
                    end

                    S_PRP_LIST_RD_LO: begin
                        if (dma_rd_req)
                            stat_prp_list_fetches <= stat_prp_list_fetches + 1'b1;
                        if (dma_rd_valid)
                            prp_entry_lo <= dma_rd_data;
                        if (dma_rd_done) begin
                            dma_rd_req  <= 1'b1;
                            dma_rd_addr <= io_prp_list_entry_addr + 64'd4;
                            dma_rd_len  <= 10'd1;
                            state <= S_PRP_LIST_RD_HI;
                        end
                    end

                    S_PRP_LIST_RD_HI: begin
                        if (dma_rd_valid)
                            prp_entry_hi <= dma_rd_data;
                        if (dma_rd_done) begin
		                            if (io_prp_list_index > PRP_LIST_MAX_ENTRIES) begin
                                    cqe_status <= NVME_SC_INVALID_FIELD;
                                    state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                end else if (prp_list_entry_invalid) begin
		                                cqe_status <= NVME_SC_PRP_OFFSET_INVALID;
		                                state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
		                            end else begin
                                prp_cached_valid <= 1'b1;
                                prp_cached_index <= io_prp_list_index;
                                prp_cached_base  <= prp_list_page_base;
                                io_host_addr <= prp_list_page_base + {52'h0000000000000, io_prp_after_first[11:0]};
                                state <= return_state;
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    S_DSM_FETCH_REQ: begin
                        dma_rd_req  <= 1'b1;
                        dma_rd_addr <= io_host_addr;
                        dma_rd_len  <= 10'd1;
                        state <= S_DSM_FETCH_WAIT;
                    end

                    S_DSM_FETCH_WAIT: begin
                        if (dma_rd_valid) begin
                            case (dsm_dw_idx)
                                2'd0: dsm_dw0 <= dma_rd_data;
                                2'd1: dsm_dw1 <= dma_rd_data;
                                2'd2: dsm_dw2 <= dma_rd_data;
                                default: dsm_dw3 <= dma_rd_data;
                            endcase
                        end

                        if (dma_rd_done) begin
                            if (dsm_dw_idx != 2'd3) begin
                                dsm_dw_idx   <= dsm_dw_idx + 1'b1;
                                io_dw_idx    <= io_dw_idx + 1'b1;
                                return_state <= S_DSM_FETCH_REQ;
                                state        <= S_RESOLVE_IO_PRP;
                            end else if (dsm_dw1 == 32'h00000000) begin
                                if (dsm_range_idx == dsm_range_last) begin
                                    state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                                end else begin
                                    dsm_range_idx <= dsm_range_next;
                                    dsm_dw_idx    <= 2'h0;
                                    io_dw_idx     <= {14'h0000, dsm_range_next, 2'b00};
                                    return_state  <= S_DSM_FETCH_REQ;
                                    state         <= S_RESOLVE_IO_PRP;
                                end
                            end else if (dsm_range_ok) begin
                                disk_req_valid <= 1'b1;
                                disk_req_write <= 1'b1;
                                disk_req_flush <= 1'b1;
                                disk_req_lba   <= dsm_lba_value;
                                disk_req_word  <= 7'h0;
                                disk_req_wdata <= dsm_dw1;
                                state          <= S_DSM_CLEAR_WAIT;
                            end else begin
                                cqe_status <= NVME_SC_LBA_RANGE;
                                state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    S_DSM_CLEAR_WAIT: begin
                        if (disk_req_done) begin
                            if (disk_error) begin
                                cqe_status <= NVME_SC_DATA_XFER_ERROR;
                                state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                            end else if (dsm_range_idx == dsm_range_last) begin
                                state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                            end else begin
                                dsm_range_idx <= dsm_range_next;
                                dsm_dw_idx    <= 2'h0;
                                io_dw_idx     <= {14'h0000, dsm_range_next, 2'b00};
                                return_state  <= S_DSM_FETCH_REQ;
                                state         <= S_RESOLVE_IO_PRP;
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    S_FORMAT_CLEAR: begin
                        if (disk_req_done) begin
                            if (disk_error)
                                cqe_status <= NVME_SC_DATA_XFER_ERROR;
                            state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                        end
                    end

                    S_IO_WRITE_DMA_REQ: begin
                        dma_rd_req  <= 1'b1;
                        dma_rd_addr <= io_host_addr;
                        dma_rd_len  <= 10'd1;
                        state <= S_IO_WRITE_DMA_WAIT;
                    end

                    S_IO_WRITE_DMA_WAIT: begin
                        if (dma_rd_valid)
                            io_host_data <= dma_rd_data;
                        if (dma_rd_done) begin
                            disk_req_valid <= 1'b1;
                            disk_req_write <= 1'b1;
                            disk_req_flush <= 1'b0;
                            disk_req_lba   <= io_disk_lba;
                            disk_req_word  <= io_disk_word;
                            disk_req_wdata <= dma_rd_valid ? dma_rd_data : io_host_data;
                            state <= S_IO_DISK_WR_WAIT;
                        end
                    end

                    S_IO_ZERO_REQ: begin
                        disk_req_valid <= 1'b1;
                        disk_req_write <= 1'b1;
                        disk_req_flush <= 1'b0;
                        disk_req_lba   <= io_disk_lba;
                        disk_req_word  <= io_disk_word;
                        disk_req_wdata <= 32'h00000000;
                        state <= S_IO_DISK_WR_WAIT;
                    end

                    S_IO_DISK_WR_WAIT: begin
                        if (disk_req_done) begin
	                            if (disk_error)
	                                cqe_status <= NVME_SC_DATA_XFER_ERROR;
                            state <= S_IO_ADVANCE;
                        end
                    end

                    S_IO_READ_DISK_REQ: begin
                        disk_req_valid <= 1'b1;
                        disk_req_write <= 1'b0;
                        disk_req_flush <= 1'b0;
                        disk_req_lba   <= io_disk_lba;
                        disk_req_word  <= io_disk_word;
                        state <= S_IO_READ_DISK_WAIT;
                    end

                    S_IO_READ_DISK_WAIT: begin
                        if (disk_req_done) begin
                            if (disk_req_hit)
                                timing_read_seen_hit <= 1'b1;
                            else
                                timing_read_seen_miss <= 1'b1;
		                            if (disk_error) begin
		                                cqe_status <= NVME_SC_DATA_XFER_ERROR;
	                                state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                            end else begin
                                io_host_data <= disk_req_rdata;
                                return_state <= S_IO_READ_HOST_WR;
                                state <= S_RESOLVE_IO_PRP;
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    S_IO_READ_HOST_WR: begin
                        dma_wr_req   <= 1'b1;
                        dma_wr_valid <= 1'b1;
                        dma_wr_addr  <= io_host_addr;
                        dma_wr_data  <= io_host_data;
                        dma_wr_be    <= 4'hF;
                        return_state <= S_IO_ADVANCE;
                        state <= S_WAIT_DMA_WR;
                    end

                    S_IO_ADVANCE: begin
                        if (io_last_dw || (cqe_status != 15'h0000)) begin
                            if ((cqe_status == 15'h0000) &&
                                ((io_dir == IO_DIR_WRITE) || (io_dir == IO_DIR_ZERO))) begin
                                state <= S_IO_FLUSH_REQ;
                            end else begin
                                state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                            end
                        end else begin
                            io_dw_idx <= io_dw_idx + 1'b1;
                            case (io_dir)
                                IO_DIR_READ: begin
                                    if (NVME_PRP_ONLY_IO) begin
                                        return_state <= S_IO_ADVANCE;
                                        state <= S_RESOLVE_IO_PRP;
                                    end else if (NVME_ZERO_IO_READS) begin
                                        io_host_data <= 32'h00000000;
                                        return_state <= S_IO_READ_HOST_WR;
                                        state <= S_RESOLVE_IO_PRP;
                                    end else begin
                                        state <= S_IO_READ_DISK_REQ;
                                    end
                                end
                                IO_DIR_ZERO:  state <= S_IO_ZERO_REQ;
                                default: begin
                                    return_state <= NVME_PRP_ONLY_IO ? S_IO_ADVANCE : S_IO_WRITE_DMA_REQ;
                                    state <= S_RESOLVE_IO_PRP;
                                end
                            endcase
                        end
                    end

                    S_IO_FLUSH_REQ: begin
                        disk_req_valid <= 1'b1;
                        disk_req_write <= 1'b0;
                        disk_req_flush <= 1'b1;
                        disk_req_lba   <= 64'h0;
                        disk_req_word  <= 7'h0;
                        state <= S_IO_FLUSH_WAIT;
                    end

                    S_IO_FLUSH_WAIT: begin
                        if (disk_req_done) begin
	                            if (disk_error)
	                                cqe_status <= NVME_SC_DATA_XFER_ERROR;
                            state <= S_BUILD_CQE;
                        end
                    end

                    S_SHUTDOWN: begin
                        if (cc_shn == 2'b00) begin
                            shutdown_complete <= 1'b0;
                            shutdown_flush_issued <= 1'b0;
                            disk_req_write <= 1'b0;
                            disk_req_flush <= 1'b0;
                            state <= S_IDLE;
                        end else if (abrupt_shutdown_requested) begin
                            disk_req_write <= 1'b0;
                            disk_req_flush <= 1'b0;
                            if (!disk_busy)
                                shutdown_complete <= 1'b1;
                        end else if (!shutdown_flush_issued) begin
                            disk_req_valid <= 1'b1;
                            disk_req_write <= 1'b0;
                            disk_req_flush <= 1'b1;
                            disk_req_lba <= 64'h0000000000000000;
                            disk_req_word <= 7'h00;
                            shutdown_flush_issued <= 1'b1;
                        end else if (disk_req_done) begin
                            if (!disk_error) begin
                                shutdown_complete <= 1'b1;
                                normal_shutdown_complete_epoch <= 1'b1;
                                disk_req_write <= 1'b0;
                                disk_req_flush <= 1'b0;
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    default: state <= S_IDLE;
                endcase
            end
        end
    end

endmodule

```

`internal/firmware/svgen/templates/nvme_bram_disk.sv.tmpl`:

```tmpl
//
// Volatile BRAM-backed LBA cache for the NVMe responder.
// [[ hex04 .DeviceIDs.VendorID ]]:[[ hex04 .DeviceIDs.DeviceID ]]
//

`timescale 1ns / 1ps

module pcileech_bram_disk #(
    parameter integer DISK_WORDS = 32768   // cache depth in 32-bit words (board-scaled at instantiation)
) (
    input               rst,
    input               clk,

    input               req_valid,
    input               req_write,
    input               req_flush,
    input [63:0]        req_lba,
    input [6:0]         req_word,
    input [31:0]        req_wdata,
    output reg          req_done,
    output reg [31:0]   req_rdata,
    output reg          req_hit,
    output reg          busy,
    output reg          error,
    output [7:0]        dbg_state,
    output [31:0]       dbg_info
);

    localparam [2:0] S_IDLE  = 3'd0;
    localparam [2:0] S_DONE  = 3'd1;
    localparam [2:0] S_CLEAR = 3'd2;
    localparam [2:0] S_RAM   = 3'd3;
    localparam [2:0] S_RAM_WAIT = 3'd4;
    localparam integer BACKING_LBAS = (DISK_WORDS < 128) ? 1 : (DISK_WORDS / 128);
    localparam integer SLOT_WIDTH = (BACKING_LBAS <= 2) ? 1 : $clog2(BACKING_LBAS);
    localparam integer ADDR_WIDTH = SLOT_WIDTH + 7;
    localparam integer CLEAR_WIDTH = ADDR_WIDTH + 1;
    localparam integer BANK_BITS = 2;
    localparam integer BANK_ADDR_WIDTH = ADDR_WIDTH - BANK_BITS;
    localparam [CLEAR_WIDTH-1:0] BACKING_COUNT = {1'b1, {ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}}};
    localparam [CLEAR_WIDTH-1:0] BACKING_ONE = {{ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}}, 1'b1};
    localparam integer PIN_WINDOW_LBAS =
        (BACKING_LBAS >= 512) ? 128 :
        (BACKING_LBAS >= 256) ? 64  :
        (BACKING_LBAS >= 128) ? 32  :
        (BACKING_LBAS >= 64)  ? 16  : 0;
    localparam integer PINNED_SLOTS = PIN_WINDOW_LBAS * 2;
    localparam [63:0]  WIN64 = 64'(PIN_WINDOW_LBAS);
    localparam integer HASH_SLOTS = (BACKING_LBAS > PINNED_SLOTS) ?
                                    (BACKING_LBAS - PINNED_SLOTS) : 1;
    localparam integer HASH_WIDTH = (HASH_SLOTS <= 2) ? 1 : $clog2(HASH_SLOTS);

    reg [2:0] state;
    reg       pending_error;
    reg        pending_clear;
    reg        pending_full_format;
    reg        pending_write;
    reg [31:0] pending_wdata;
    reg [63:0] pending_lba;
    reg [SLOT_WIDTH-1:0] pending_slot;
    reg [6:0]  pending_word;
    reg        pending_hit;
    reg [63:0] clear_base_lba;
    reg [CLEAR_WIDTH-1:0] clear_idx;
    reg [CLEAR_WIDTH-1:0] clear_total_dw;

    (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg        cache_valid [0:BACKING_LBAS-1];
    (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [63:0] cache_tag   [0:BACKING_LBAS-1];
    reg [BANK_BITS-1:0] read_bank_q;

    // NTFS boot sector snoop: pin boot sector + $MFT from BPB
    //   BPB byte offsets / 32-bit LE word (= byte>>2):
    //   w0[7:0]=jump(EB/E9)  w0[31:24]='N'  w1[23:0]="TFS"  w3[15:8]=sectors/cluster
    //   w12=MFT_LCN[31:0]  w13=MFT_LCN[63:32]  w127[31:16]=0xAA55
    reg        boot_armed;
    reg [63:0] pin_boot_lba;
    reg [7:0]  fmt_spc;
    reg [63:0] fmt_mft_lcn;
    reg        mft_armed;
    reg [63:0] pin_mft_lba;

    // word 0 routes to boot slot same cycle (registered pin lags 1)
    wire boot_detect_now = req_valid && req_write && !req_flush &&
                           (req_word == 7'd0) &&
                           ((req_wdata[7:0] == 8'hEB) || (req_wdata[7:0] == 8'hE9)) &&
                           (req_wdata[31:24] == 8'h4E);   // 'N'
    // after first boot sector, ignore stray jump+'N' writes
    wire        boot_route_now = boot_detect_now && !boot_armed;
    wire        eff_boot_armed = boot_armed || boot_route_now;
    wire [63:0] eff_pin_boot   = boot_route_now ? req_lba : pin_boot_lba;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            boot_armed   <= 1'b0;
            pin_boot_lba <= 64'd0;
            fmt_spc      <= 8'd0;
            fmt_mft_lcn  <= 64'd0;
            mft_armed    <= 1'b0;
            pin_mft_lba  <= 64'd0;
        end else if (req_valid && req_write && !req_flush) begin
            if (req_word == 7'd0) begin
                if (boot_route_now) begin
                    // latch LBA + reset BPB
                    boot_armed   <= 1'b1;
                    pin_boot_lba <= req_lba;
                    fmt_spc      <= 8'd0;
                    fmt_mft_lcn  <= 64'd0;
                end
            end else if (pin_boot_lba == req_lba) begin
                // accumulate BPB fields
                if (req_word == 7'd1) begin
                    // Confirm "TFS" at bytes 0x004..0x006; else it isn't NTFS.
                    if (req_wdata[23:0] != 24'h534654)
                        boot_armed <= 1'b0;
                end else if (req_word == 7'd3) begin
                    fmt_spc <= req_wdata[15:8];             // byte 0x00D
                end else if (req_word == 7'd12) begin
                    fmt_mft_lcn[31:0] <= req_wdata;         // 0x030
                end else if (req_word == 7'd13) begin
                    fmt_mft_lcn[63:32] <= req_wdata;        // 0x034
                end else if (req_word == 7'd127) begin
                    if (req_wdata[31:16] == 16'hAA55) begin
                        pin_mft_lba <= pin_boot_lba + (fmt_mft_lcn * {56'h0, fmt_spc});
                        mft_armed   <= 1'b1;
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    function [SLOT_WIDTH-1:0] backing_slot;
        input [63:0] lba;
        reg [11:0] mix;
        reg [63:0] boot_off;
        reg [63:0] mft_off;
        reg [HASH_WIDTH-1:0] hash_slot;
        begin
            mix = lba[11:0] ^ lba[23:12] ^ lba[35:24] ^
                  lba[47:36] ^ lba[59:48] ^ {8'h00, lba[63:60]};
            boot_off = lba - eff_pin_boot;
            mft_off  = lba - pin_mft_lba;
            hash_slot = mix[HASH_WIDTH-1:0];

            if ((PIN_WINDOW_LBAS != 0) && mft_armed &&
                (lba >= pin_mft_lba) && (mft_off < WIN64)) begin
                backing_slot = mft_off[SLOT_WIDTH-1:0];                                // [0, W)
            end else if ((PIN_WINDOW_LBAS != 0) && eff_boot_armed &&
                         (lba >= eff_pin_boot) && (boot_off < WIN64)) begin
                backing_slot = boot_off[SLOT_WIDTH-1:0] + PIN_WINDOW_LBAS[SLOT_WIDTH-1:0]; // [W, 2W)
            end else begin
                backing_slot = hash_slot + PINNED_SLOTS[SLOT_WIDTH-1:0];               // hash pool
            end
        end
    endfunction

    function [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] backing_index;
        input [63:0] lba;
        input [6:0]  word_off;
        begin
            backing_index = {backing_slot(lba), word_off};
        end
    endfunction

    function [63:0] clear_lba_offset;
        input [CLEAR_WIDTH-1:0] idx;
        begin
            clear_lba_offset = {{(64-(CLEAR_WIDTH-7)){1'b0}}, idx[CLEAR_WIDTH-1:7]};
        end
    endfunction

    function [CLEAR_WIDTH-1:0] lba_count_to_dw;
        input [31:0] lba_count;
        begin
            if (lba_count == 32'h00000000)
                lba_count_to_dw = {{(CLEAR_WIDTH-8){1'b0}}, 8'h80};
            else if (lba_count >= BACKING_LBAS)
                lba_count_to_dw = BACKING_COUNT;
            else
                lba_count_to_dw = {1'b0, lba_count[SLOT_WIDTH-1:0], 7'h00};
        end
    endfunction

    wire [SLOT_WIDTH-1:0] req_slot = backing_slot(req_lba);
    wire req_slot_hit = cache_valid[req_slot] && (cache_tag[req_slot] == req_lba);
    wire req_word_cached = req_slot_hit;

    wire pending_word_cached =
        pending_hit &&
        cache_valid[pending_slot] &&
        (cache_tag[pending_slot] == pending_lba);
    wire [63:0] clear_lba = clear_base_lba + clear_lba_offset(clear_idx);
    wire [6:0] clear_word = clear_idx[6:0];
    wire [SLOT_WIDTH-1:0] clear_format_slot = clear_idx[ADDR_WIDTH-1:7];
    wire [SLOT_WIDTH-1:0] clear_slot = pending_full_format ? clear_format_slot : backing_slot(clear_lba);
    wire [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] clear_ram_addr = pending_full_format ?
                                            clear_idx[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] :
                                            backing_index(clear_lba, clear_word);
    wire [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] data_ram_addr = backing_index(pending_lba, pending_word);
    wire mem_clear = (state == S_CLEAR) && !pending_error;
    wire mem_write = (state == S_RAM) && !pending_error && pending_write;
    wire mem_read = (state == S_RAM) && !pending_error && !pending_write && pending_word_cached;
    wire [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] mem_addr = mem_clear ? clear_ram_addr : data_ram_addr;
    wire [BANK_BITS-1:0] mem_bank = mem_addr[BANK_BITS-1:0];
    wire [BANK_ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] mem_bank_addr = mem_addr[ADDR_WIDTH-1:BANK_BITS];
    wire [31:0] mem_wdata = mem_clear ? 32'h00000000 : pending_wdata;
    wire mem_active = mem_clear || mem_write || mem_read;
    wire mem_we = mem_clear || mem_write;
    wire [31:0] bank_dout0;
    wire [31:0] bank_dout1;
    wire [31:0] bank_dout2;
    wire [31:0] bank_dout3;
    wire [31:0] ram_dout =
        (read_bank_q == 2'd0) ? bank_dout0 :
        (read_bank_q == 2'd1) ? bank_dout1 :
        (read_bank_q == 2'd2) ? bank_dout2 :
                                bank_dout3;
    wire [15:0] req_slot_dbg = {{(16-SLOT_WIDTH){1'b0}}, req_slot};
    wire [15:0] pending_slot_dbg = {{(16-SLOT_WIDTH){1'b0}}, pending_slot};
    integer reset_idx;

    assign dbg_state = {5'h00, state};
    assign dbg_info = {
        pending_slot_dbg[7:0],
        pending_word,
        pending_write,
        req_slot_dbg[7:0],
        state,
        req_slot_hit,
        pending_hit,
        pending_word_cached,
        cache_valid[req_slot],
        cache_valid[pending_slot]
    };

    pcileech_bram_disk_bank #(
        .ADDR_WIDTH ( BANK_ADDR_WIDTH )
    ) i_bank0 (
        .clk  ( clk                                      ),
        .en   ( mem_active && (mem_bank == 2'd0)         ),
        .we   ( mem_we && (mem_bank == 2'd0)             ),
        .addr ( mem_bank_addr                            ),
        .din  ( mem_wdata                                ),
        .dout ( bank_dout0                               )
    );

    pcileech_bram_disk_bank #(
        .ADDR_WIDTH ( BANK_ADDR_WIDTH )
    ) i_bank1 (
        .clk  ( clk                                      ),
        .en   ( mem_active && (mem_bank == 2'd1)         ),
        .we   ( mem_we && (mem_bank == 2'd1)             ),
        .addr ( mem_bank_addr                            ),
        .din  ( mem_wdata                                ),
        .dout ( bank_dout1                               )
    );

    pcileech_bram_disk_bank #(
        .ADDR_WIDTH ( BANK_ADDR_WIDTH )
    ) i_bank2 (
        .clk  ( clk                                      ),
        .en   ( mem_active && (mem_bank == 2'd2)         ),
        .we   ( mem_we && (mem_bank == 2'd2)             ),
        .addr ( mem_bank_addr                            ),
        .din  ( mem_wdata                                ),
        .dout ( bank_dout2                               )
    );

    pcileech_bram_disk_bank #(
        .ADDR_WIDTH ( BANK_ADDR_WIDTH )
    ) i_bank3 (
        .clk  ( clk                                      ),
        .en   ( mem_active && (mem_bank == 2'd3)         ),
        .we   ( mem_we && (mem_bank == 2'd3)             ),
        .addr ( mem_bank_addr                            ),
        .din  ( mem_wdata                                ),
        .dout ( bank_dout3                               )
    );

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            state         <= S_IDLE;
            req_done      <= 1'b0;
            req_rdata     <= 32'h00000000;
            req_hit       <= 1'b0;
            busy          <= 1'b0;
            error         <= 1'b0;
            pending_error <= 1'b0;
            pending_clear <= 1'b0;
            pending_full_format <= 1'b0;
            pending_write <= 1'b0;
            pending_wdata <= 32'h00000000;
            pending_lba   <= 64'h0000000000000000;
            pending_slot  <= {SLOT_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            pending_word  <= 7'h0;
            pending_hit   <= 1'b0;
            read_bank_q   <= {BANK_BITS{1'b0}};
            clear_base_lba <= 64'h0000000000000000;
            clear_idx <= {CLEAR_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            clear_total_dw <= {CLEAR_WIDTH{1'b0}};
            for (reset_idx = 0; reset_idx < BACKING_LBAS; reset_idx = reset_idx + 1) begin
                cache_valid[reset_idx] = 1'b0;
                cache_tag[reset_idx]   = 64'h0000000000000000;
            end
        end else begin
            req_done <= 1'b0;
            req_hit  <= 1'b0;
            if (mem_read)
                read_bank_q <= mem_bank;

            case (state)
                S_IDLE: begin
                    busy  <= 1'b0;
                    error <= 1'b0;

                    if (req_valid) begin
                        busy <= 1'b1;
                        pending_write <= req_write;
                        pending_wdata <= req_wdata;
                        pending_lba   <= req_lba;
                        pending_slot  <= req_slot;
                        pending_word  <= req_word;
                        pending_hit   <= req_slot_hit;
                        pending_clear <= req_flush && req_write;
                        pending_full_format <= req_flush && req_write &&
                                               (req_lba == 64'h0000000000000000) &&
                                               (req_wdata == 32'hFFFFFFFF);
                        clear_base_lba <= req_lba;
                        clear_idx <= {CLEAR_WIDTH{1'b0}};
                        clear_total_dw <= ((req_lba == 64'h0000000000000000) &&
                                           (req_wdata == 32'hFFFFFFFF)) ?
                                          BACKING_COUNT :
                                          lba_count_to_dw(req_wdata);

                        pending_error <= 1'b0;

                        if (req_flush && req_write) begin
                            state <= S_CLEAR;
                        end else if (req_flush) begin
                            state <= S_DONE;
                        end else if (req_write || req_word_cached) begin
                            state <= S_RAM;
                        end else begin
                            state <= S_DONE;
                        end
                    end
                end

                S_CLEAR: begin
                    busy <= 1'b1;
                    if (pending_full_format) begin
                        if (clear_word == 7'h00) begin
                            cache_valid[clear_format_slot] <= 1'b0;
                            cache_tag[clear_format_slot]   <= 64'h0000000000000000;
                        end
                    end else begin
                        cache_valid[clear_slot] <= 1'b1;
                        cache_tag[clear_slot]   <= clear_lba;
                    end

                    if ((clear_idx + BACKING_ONE) >= clear_total_dw) begin
                        state <= S_DONE;
                    end else begin
                        clear_idx <= clear_idx + BACKING_ONE;
                    end
                end

                S_RAM: begin
                    busy <= 1'b1;
                    if (!pending_error && pending_write) begin
                        cache_valid[pending_slot] <= 1'b1;
                        cache_tag[pending_slot]   <= pending_lba;
                    end
                    if (!pending_error && !pending_write && pending_word_cached)
                        state <= S_RAM_WAIT;
                    else
                        state <= S_DONE;
                end

                S_RAM_WAIT: begin
                    busy <= 1'b1;
                    state <= S_DONE;
                end

                S_DONE: begin
                    req_done <= 1'b1;
                    req_hit  <= pending_word_cached || pending_write || pending_clear;
                    busy     <= 1'b0;
                    error    <= pending_error;
                    if (!pending_error) begin
                        if (pending_clear) begin
                            req_rdata <= 32'h00000000;
                        end else if (pending_write) begin
                            req_rdata <= pending_wdata;
                        end else if (pending_word_cached) begin
                            req_rdata <= ram_dout;
                        end else begin
                            req_rdata <= 32'h00000000;
                        end
                    end
                    state    <= S_IDLE;
                end

                default: state <= S_IDLE;
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule

module pcileech_bram_disk_bank #(
    parameter integer ADDR_WIDTH = 13
) (
    input                    clk,
    input                    en,
    input                    we,
    input [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]   addr,
    input [31:0]             din,
    output reg [31:0]        dout
);

    (* ram_style = "block" *) reg [31:0] ram [0:(1 << ADDR_WIDTH)-1];

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (en) begin
            if (we)
                ram[addr] <= din;
            dout <= ram[addr];
        end
    end

endmodule

```

`internal/firmware/svgen/templates/nvme_dma_bridge.sv.tmpl`:

```tmpl
//
// NVMe DMA Bridge - converts admin-responder DMA requests into PCIe
// MRd/MWr TLPs on PCILeech's 128-bit AXI-stream path.
// {{ hex04 .DeviceIDs.VendorID }}:{{ hex04 .DeviceIDs.DeviceID }}
//

`timescale 1ns / 1ps

module pcileech_nvme_dma_bridge(
    input               rst,
    input               clk,
    input               dma_enabled,
    input tri0          dma_cancel,

    input [15:0]        pcie_id,

    // write side - from admin responder
    input               dma_wr_req,
    input [63:0]        dma_wr_addr,
    input [31:0]        dma_wr_data,
    input [3:0]         dma_wr_be,
    input               dma_wr_valid,
    output reg          dma_wr_done,

    // read side - from admin responder
    input               dma_rd_req,
    input [63:0]        dma_rd_addr,
    input [9:0]         dma_rd_len,
    output reg          dma_rd_valid,
    output reg [31:0]   dma_rd_data,
    output reg          dma_rd_done,

    // outgoing TLP stream - muxed with BAR read completions
    output reg [127:0]  tlp_tx_tdata,
    output reg [3:0]    tlp_tx_tkeepdw,
    output reg          tlp_tx_tvalid,
    output reg          tlp_tx_tlast,
    output reg [8:0]    tlp_tx_tuser,
    input               tlp_tx_tready,

    // incoming TLP snoop - used to catch CplD for our MRd tags
    input [127:0]       tlp_rx_tdata,
    input [3:0]         tlp_rx_tkeepdw,
    input               tlp_rx_tvalid,
    input [8:0]         tlp_rx_tuser,

    output [31:0]       dbg_status
);

    localparam [3:0] B_IDLE     = 4'h0;
    localparam [3:0] B_WR_SEND  = 4'h1;
    localparam [3:0] B_WR_SEND2 = 4'h2;
    localparam [3:0] B_WR_DONE  = 4'h3;
    localparam [3:0] B_RD_SEND  = 4'h4;
    localparam [3:0] B_RD_WAIT  = 4'h5;
    localparam [3:0] B_RD_EMIT  = 4'h6;

    reg [3:0]  bstate;
    reg [7:0]  rd_active_tag;
    reg [63:0] rd_base_addr;
    reg [9:0]  rd_remaining;
    reg [9:0]  rd_index;
    reg [31:0] rd_payload;

    reg [31:0] wr_data_hold;
    reg        wr_pending;
    reg [63:0] wr_pending_addr;
    reg [31:0] wr_pending_data;
    reg [3:0]  wr_pending_be;
    reg        rd_pending;
    reg [63:0] rd_pending_addr;
    reg [9:0]  rd_pending_len;
    reg        rd_cancel_notify_pending;

    localparam [7:0] NVME_RD_TAG_FIRST = 8'h10;
    // Reorder Xilinx pcie_id {func,dev,bus} -> PCIe Requester ID {bus,dev,func}.
    wire [15:0] pcie_id_fmt = {pcie_id[12:8], pcie_id[15:13], pcie_id[7:0]};


    wire [9:0]  rd_next_index = rd_index + 10'd1;
    wire [63:0] rd_next_addr  = rd_base_addr + {52'h0, rd_next_index, 2'b00};

    wire [2:0] cpld_status = tlp_rx_tdata[47:45];
    wire cpld_has_data = (tlp_rx_tdata[31:25] == 7'b0100101);
    wire cpld_any = tlp_rx_tvalid &&
                    tlp_rx_tuser[0] &&
                    (cpld_has_data ||
                     (tlp_rx_tdata[31:25] == 7'b0000101));
    wire cpld_tag_match = cpld_any && (tlp_rx_tdata[79:72] == rd_active_tag);
    wire cpld_match = cpld_tag_match && cpld_has_data &&
                      (cpld_status == 3'b000);
    wire cpld_error = cpld_tag_match &&
                      (!cpld_has_data || (cpld_status != 3'b000));
    wire        tag_alloc_ready;
    wire [7:0]  tag_alloc_tag;
    reg         tag_alloc_valid;
    wire        tag_outcome_valid;
    wire [7:0]  tag_outcome_tag;
    wire [1:0]  tag_outcome_status;

    pcileech_dma_tag_service #(
        .TAG_FIRST      ( NVME_RD_TAG_FIRST ),
        .TAG_COUNT      ( 16                ),
        .TIMEOUT_CYCLES ( 24'h4C4B40        ),
        .TIMEOUT_WIDTH  ( 24                )
    ) i_dma_tag_service(
        .clk                ( clk                    ),
        .rst                ( rst                    ),
        .alloc_valid        ( tag_alloc_valid        ),
        .alloc_ready        ( tag_alloc_ready        ),
        .alloc_tag          ( tag_alloc_tag          ),
        .completion_valid   ( cpld_tag_match         ),
        .completion_tag     ( tlp_rx_tdata[79:72]    ),
        .completion_error   ( cpld_error             ),
        .cancel_all         ( !dma_enabled || dma_cancel ),
        .outcome_valid      ( tag_outcome_valid      ),
        .outcome_ready      ( 1'b1                   ),
        .outcome_tag        ( tag_outcome_tag        ),
        .outcome_status     ( tag_outcome_status     ),
        .active_tags        (                        ),
        .outstanding_count  (                        )
    );

    assign dbg_status = {cpld_any, cpld_tag_match, cpld_match, cpld_status,
                         bstate, rd_active_tag, tag_alloc_tag, rd_remaining[5:0]};

    function [15:0] bs16;
        input [15:0] value;
        begin
            bs16 = {value[7:0], value[15:8]};
        end
    endfunction

    function [31:0] swap32;
        input [31:0] value;
        begin
            swap32 = {value[7:0], value[15:8], value[23:16], value[31:24]};
        end
    endfunction

    function [31:0] tlp_dw0;
        input [2:0] fmt;
        input [9:0] length_dw;
        begin
            tlp_dw0 = {fmt, 5'b00000, 1'b0, 3'b000, 4'b0000,
                       1'b0, 1'b0, 2'b00, 2'b00, length_dw};
        end
    endfunction

    task load_mwr1;
        input [63:0] addr;
        input [31:0] data;
        input [3:0]  be;
        begin
            tlp_tx_tvalid <= 1'b1;
            tlp_tx_tuser  <= {8'h00, 1'b1};

            // Keep the NVMe DMA path on 4DW TLPs even for <4 GiB host
            // addresses. The surrounding PCILeech 128-bit path and earlier
            // stable builds used this layout; switching to 3DW MRd/MWr caused
            // host SQE fetches to sit in B_RD_WAIT without a CplD.
            tlp_tx_tdata   <= {
                {addr[31:2], 2'b00},
                addr[63:32],
                // Single-DW requests must use Last DW BE = 0 and put the
                // byte mask in First DW BE. Some root complexes reject
                // length-1 requests with Last DW BE set.
                {bs16(pcie_id_fmt), 8'h00, 4'h0, be},
                tlp_dw0(3'b011, 10'd1)
            };
            tlp_tx_tkeepdw <= 4'b1111;
            tlp_tx_tlast   <= 1'b0;
        end
    endtask

    task load_mrd1;
        input [63:0] addr;
        input [7:0]  tag;
        begin
            tlp_tx_tvalid <= 1'b1;
            tlp_tx_tlast  <= 1'b1;
            tlp_tx_tuser  <= {8'h00, 1'b1};

            tlp_tx_tdata   <= {
                {addr[31:2], 2'b00},
                addr[63:32],
                {bs16(pcie_id_fmt), tag, 4'h0, 4'hF},
                tlp_dw0(3'b001, 10'd1)
            };
            tlp_tx_tkeepdw <= 4'b1111;
        end
    endtask

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst) begin
            bstate          <= B_IDLE;
            dma_wr_done     <= 1'b0;
            dma_rd_valid    <= 1'b0;
            dma_rd_done     <= 1'b0;
            dma_rd_data     <= 32'h0;
            tlp_tx_tdata    <= 128'h0;
            tlp_tx_tkeepdw  <= 4'h0;
            tlp_tx_tvalid   <= 1'b0;
            tlp_tx_tlast    <= 1'b0;
            tlp_tx_tuser    <= 9'h0;
            rd_active_tag   <= NVME_RD_TAG_FIRST;
            rd_base_addr    <= 64'h0;
            rd_remaining    <= 10'h0;
            rd_index        <= 10'h0;
            rd_payload      <= 32'h0;
            wr_data_hold    <= 32'h0;
            wr_pending      <= 1'b0;
            wr_pending_addr <= 64'h0;
            wr_pending_data <= 32'h0;
            wr_pending_be   <= 4'hF;
            rd_pending      <= 1'b0;
            rd_pending_addr <= 64'h0;
            rd_pending_len  <= 10'h0;
            rd_cancel_notify_pending <= 1'b0;
            tag_alloc_valid <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            dma_wr_done  <= 1'b0;
            dma_rd_valid <= 1'b0;
            dma_rd_done  <= 1'b0;
            tag_alloc_valid <= 1'b0;
            if (rd_cancel_notify_pending) begin
                dma_rd_done <= 1'b1;
                rd_cancel_notify_pending <= 1'b0;
            end

            if (!dma_enabled) begin
                wr_pending <= 1'b0;
                rd_pending <= 1'b0;
            end else if (dma_cancel) begin
                rd_pending <= 1'b0;
            end
            if (dma_enabled && (bstate != B_IDLE)) begin
                if (dma_wr_valid && !wr_pending) begin
                    wr_pending      <= 1'b1;
                    wr_pending_addr <= dma_wr_addr;
                    wr_pending_data <= dma_wr_data;
                    wr_pending_be   <= dma_wr_be;
                end
                if (!dma_cancel && dma_rd_req &&
                    (dma_rd_len != 10'd0) && !rd_pending) begin
                    rd_pending      <= 1'b1;
                    rd_pending_addr <= dma_rd_addr;
                    rd_pending_len  <= dma_rd_len;
                end
            end

            case (bstate)
                B_IDLE: begin
                    tlp_tx_tvalid <= 1'b0;
                    tlp_tx_tlast  <= 1'b0;
                    tlp_tx_tuser  <= 9'h0;

                    if (dma_enabled && wr_pending) begin
                        wr_data_hold <= wr_pending_data;
                        load_mwr1(wr_pending_addr, wr_pending_data, wr_pending_be);
                        wr_pending <= 1'b0;
                        bstate <= B_WR_SEND;
                    end else if (dma_enabled && dma_wr_valid) begin
                        wr_data_hold <= dma_wr_data;
                        load_mwr1(dma_wr_addr, dma_wr_data, dma_wr_be);
                        bstate <= B_WR_SEND;
                    end else if (dma_enabled && !dma_cancel && rd_pending && tag_alloc_ready) begin
                        rd_base_addr  <= rd_pending_addr;
                        rd_remaining  <= rd_pending_len;
                        rd_index      <= 10'd0;
                        rd_active_tag <= tag_alloc_tag;
                        tag_alloc_valid <= 1'b1;
                        load_mrd1(rd_pending_addr, tag_alloc_tag);
                        rd_pending <= 1'b0;
                        bstate <= B_RD_SEND;
                    end else if (dma_enabled && !dma_cancel && dma_rd_req &&
                                 (dma_rd_len != 10'd0) && tag_alloc_ready) begin
                        rd_base_addr  <= dma_rd_addr;
                        rd_remaining  <= dma_rd_len;
                        rd_index      <= 10'd0;
                        rd_active_tag <= tag_alloc_tag;
                        tag_alloc_valid <= 1'b1;
                        load_mrd1(dma_rd_addr, tag_alloc_tag);
                        bstate <= B_RD_SEND;
                    end else if (dma_enabled && dma_cancel && dma_rd_req) begin
                        rd_cancel_notify_pending <= 1'b1;
                    end else if (dma_enabled && dma_rd_req) begin
                        dma_rd_done <= 1'b1;
                    end
                end

                B_WR_SEND: begin
                    if (tlp_tx_tvalid && tlp_tx_tready) begin
                        if (tlp_tx_tlast) begin
                            tlp_tx_tvalid <= 1'b0;
                            bstate <= B_WR_DONE;
                        end else begin
                            tlp_tx_tdata   <= {96'h0, swap32(wr_data_hold)};
                            tlp_tx_tkeepdw <= 4'b0001;
                            tlp_tx_tlast   <= 1'b1;
                            tlp_tx_tuser   <= 9'h0;
                            tlp_tx_tvalid  <= 1'b1;
                            bstate <= B_WR_SEND2;
                        end
                    end
                end

                B_WR_SEND2: begin
                    if (tlp_tx_tvalid && tlp_tx_tready) begin
                        tlp_tx_tvalid <= 1'b0;
                        bstate <= B_WR_DONE;
                    end
                end

                B_WR_DONE: begin
                    dma_wr_done <= 1'b1;
                    bstate <= B_IDLE;
                end

                B_RD_SEND: begin
                    if (!dma_enabled || dma_cancel) begin
                        tlp_tx_tvalid <= 1'b0;
                        rd_remaining <= 10'd0;
                        rd_cancel_notify_pending <= 1'b1;
                        bstate <= B_IDLE;
                    end else if (tlp_tx_tvalid && tlp_tx_tready) begin
                        tlp_tx_tvalid <= 1'b0;
                        bstate <= B_RD_WAIT;
                    end
                end

                B_RD_WAIT: begin
                    if (!dma_enabled || dma_cancel) begin
                        rd_payload <= 32'h0;
                        rd_remaining <= 10'd0;
                        rd_cancel_notify_pending <= 1'b1;
                        bstate <= B_IDLE;
                    end else if (cpld_match) begin
                        rd_payload <= swap32(tlp_rx_tdata[127:96]);
                        bstate <= B_RD_EMIT;
                    end else if (cpld_error) begin
                        rd_payload <= 32'h0;
                        rd_remaining <= 10'h0;
                        dma_rd_done <= 1'b1;
                        bstate <= B_IDLE;
                    end else if (tag_outcome_valid &&
                                 (tag_outcome_tag == rd_active_tag) &&
                                 (tag_outcome_status != 2'd0)) begin
                        rd_payload <= 32'h0;
                        rd_remaining <= 10'h0;
                        dma_rd_done <= 1'b1;
                        bstate <= B_IDLE;
                end
                end

                B_RD_EMIT: begin
                    if (!dma_enabled || dma_cancel) begin
                        rd_remaining <= 10'd0;
                        rd_cancel_notify_pending <= 1'b1;
                        bstate <= B_IDLE;
                    end else begin
                        dma_rd_data  <= rd_payload;
                        dma_rd_valid <= 1'b1;
                        if (rd_remaining <= 10'd1) begin
                            dma_rd_done  <= 1'b1;
                            rd_remaining <= 10'd0;
                            bstate <= B_IDLE;
                        end else begin
                            rd_remaining  <= rd_remaining - 10'd1;
                            rd_index      <= rd_next_index;
                            rd_active_tag <= tag_alloc_tag;
                            tag_alloc_valid <= 1'b1;
                            load_mrd1(rd_next_addr, tag_alloc_tag);
                            bstate <= B_RD_SEND;
                        end
                    end
                end

                default: begin
                    tlp_tx_tvalid <= 1'b0;
                    bstate <= B_IDLE;
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule

```

`internal/firmware/svgen/templates/transaction_normalizer.sv.tmpl`:

```tmpl
`timescale 1ns / 1ps

module pcileech_tlp_normalizer #(
    parameter integer READ_COMPLETION_BOUNDARY = {{ .ResolvedReadCompletionBoundaryBytes }},
    parameter integer MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES         = {{ .ResolvedMaxPayloadBytes }}
)(
    input  wire [127:0] tlp_data,
    input  wire [8:0]   tlp_user,
    input  wire         tlp_last,

    output reg          request_present,
    output reg          request_supported,
    output reg          unsupported_request,
    output reg          ur_required,
    output reg          non_posted_request,
    output reg          malformed_request,
    output reg          posted_write,
    output reg          memory_read,
    output reg          memory_write,
    output reg  [2:0]   request_kind,
    output reg          header_4dw,
    output reg  [63:0]  address,
    output reg  [10:0]  length_dw,
    output reg  [3:0]   first_be,
    output reg  [3:0]   last_be,
    output reg  [15:0]  requester_id,
    output reg  [7:0]   tag,
    output reg  [2:0]   traffic_class,
    output reg  [2:0]   attributes,
    output reg  [2:0]   bir,
    output reg  [6:0]   bar_mask,

    output reg  [12:0]  enabled_byte_count,
    output reg  [12:0]  first_completion_byte_count,
    output reg  [10:0]  first_completion_dw,
    output reg  [6:0]   first_lower_address
);
```
